If you do as well, take the time to change the setting for the rinse aid dispenser. Everything will come out dry and your glasses will have no hard water film on them.

Sentence (English): With so many dishwashers, I had a really hard time deciding which one to buy.
Comments (English): With so many dishwashers, I had a really hard time deciding which one to buy. Which brand to buy, and even within that brand, what features and functions should I choose? I had absolutely no idea. In the deluge of information, I was completely lost. To those struggling like me, I can only say, "Buy this! This product! Buy it!" That's the bottom line. I researched on YouTube, blogs, and even asked real users around me. After researching, I found that most people don't use steam or hot air dryers. (The common consensus among experienced users was that they only use the basic drying feature of hot air dryers due to the high electricity bill.) Most people only use them for washing and basic drying, so I wanted something that truly delivers on the basics. With a simple design and color that wouldn't detract from the aesthetics of their kitchen, this was the perfect fit. It's a product that delivers on the basics while also being incredibly cost-effective! With the Chuseok sale, it was even cheaper, so I couldn't resist. And since it's a Grade 1 product, I'm eligible for a 10% government rebate. After finalizing my purchase, I couldn't wait for delivery. And now that it's delivered and installed, wow! I'm so happy! First of all, it's so neat and pretty, and it blends seamlessly into my kitchen! The beige dishwasher pairs beautifully with the white sink. It's also easy and simple to use. Don't worry, it has a built-in drying function, even without steam or hot air drying. The dishwasher's operating and draining noises are surprisingly quiet. I was worried it would be noisy, but it was surprisingly quiet. It makes a water noise similar to a washing machine, but it's so much quieter that I keep checking to see if it's running smoothly. ^^;;. So, no worries about noise! There were two things that bothered me when I was considering buying this product. One was that the display was on the front, not the top. I prefer the top or the front. If you have a preference, that's probably the right choice. I didn't really have a preference, so I chose the top or front because I didn't think it would be too inconvenient. Yes, I'm not sure if it's inconvenient. The dishwasher seems to remember the settings by default. So, all I had to do was press the power button and the start button, so it was hassle-free. A friend of mine said having the buttons on the top was convenient, but I found the front one to be comfortable as well. Second, the two-tier tray was a bit concerning because some people said three-tier trays were more convenient. I was fine with the two-tier one, though. The clip at the top can be moved around. I was able to use it without any major issues. So, I'm extremely satisfied with the product. Finally, the most satisfying thing was the installer. I highly recommend him. (Technician Lee 0-ju! The best!). I highly recommend him for his after-sales service. I couldn't believe how gentle and sweet the installer was! Before the installation, he explained various things that could happen after the installation. "Is this okay? How about this? Could you look into this? If it's okay, I'll proceed." He was the type to ask me very detailed questions, explain things, and have a conversation. He was incredibly kind, humble, and polite. It was so helpful to us that you gave us so many useful tips on things that could happen in the future and things to watch out for. A neat and beautiful installation was a given. They were extremely careful to minimize any gaps between the sink and the unit. LG. I don't know how you train your technicians, but... I give you so much credit! I already only use LG appliances, and I will continue to use LG! LG is the best! The technician who came to our house and installed it was even better! The best! Thank you so much! Sentence (English): After moving, I decided to change from a 6-seater to a 12-seater and chose this product after much deliberation.
Comments (English): After moving, I decided to change from a 6-seater to a 12-seater and chose this product after much deliberation. When I first used it, it had severe water stains, similar to other products. However, the water stains disappear with use. I've used both the LG 12 and Samsung 6, and this seems to have the same problem. Is it just the way it is? Will it disappear with use? Same. Sometimes, the dishes come out just after washing. Like a grease-stained lunch box. In this case, if you wipe it with a sponge and put it back in when you wash the dishwasher, it will be cleaned thoroughly. As for the basket? Only the bottom part is detachable, so when you put dishes in the top, water spills on the bottom, which is inconvenient. It comes out, but I don't want to take it out because it seems like it would be harder to put the dishes in and put them back in. It can't be removed. There's a separate cutlery holder, so when there aren't many dishes, it's convenient to just swirl the bottom. There's an additional drying function, but since I leave it until it's completely dry anyway, it's not inconvenient now. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Sentence (English): I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August.
Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. Sentence (English): Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes.
Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Sentence (English): Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes.
Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!
