Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. 한 번에 500g 인가 들어가고 한 번 넣으면 반년 정도 쓴다는 거 같은데 기억이 가물가물하네요... 큰 비용이 들어가는 건 아니지만 식세기 전용 세제, 린스, 해당 제품만의 소금까지... 추가적인 비용이 들어가는 점 참고하시면 좋을 거 같습니다.  2. 물 비린내 해당 제품 사용 시 식기류는 정말 깨끗한데 물 비린내(?) 같이 냄새가 조금 났습니다. 다른 식기세척기도 그런 건지 제가 이 제품으로 입문을 해서 모르겠지만 물 비린내가 난다는 점은 참고해 주시고 이걸 잡기 위해서 세제를 써줘야 한다는 거 같습니다. 저희는 지금 식세기 세제로 유명한 제품을 쓰고 있고 물 비린내가 없어졌습니다.  ■개인적인 생각■ 세척력 새 제품 세척 시 ★★★★★ 식사 후 그대로 세척 시  ★★☆☆☆ 식사 후 애벌 후 세척 시 ★★★★★  솔직하게 말씀드리자면 세척력에 대해 말씀드릴 부분이 많습니다. 처음에 새로운 그릇들과 냄비 등 식기류를 사 와서 세척기에 넣고 돌렸을 때 정말 신통방통했습니다. 굉장히 깔끔하게 세척이 되었고 뽀드득 소리까지 날 정도였으니 그러다 한 번은 집들이 후 대충 물로 헹군 뒤 세척을 돌렸고 다음 날 경악했습니다. 식기를 많이 넣어 그럴 수도 있겠지만 그릇 내부에 고춧가루, 밥풀 등등 제대로 세척이 되지 않았던 거죠... 그리고 요새는 물로 애벌 후 식세기를 돌리는데 그 결과는 천지차이로 정말 깨끗하게 잘 되니  어느 정도 애벌은 필요하다가 결론입니다.  여기서 애벌이라고 하면 많은 분들이 그럴 거면 손으로 하지 굳이 왜?라는 말씀을 많이 하시는데 저희도 저와 와이프 둘이 먹은 것은 손 설거지 합니다. 다만 손님들이 왔을 때 새 식기류를 샀을 때 그리고 약간의 귀찮음이 많아지는 그런 날 이 식세기가 큰 도움이 되기 때문에  저는 다시 돌아가도 무조건 식세기 구매합니다.  ■총평■ 해당 제품은 단순히 설거지라는 가사 노동을 대신해 주는 기계를 넘어 가족의 위생을 책임지고  퇴근 후 귀중한 개인 정비 시간을 돌려주는 '삶의 질 상승 아이템'입니다. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 초기 비용과 세척 시간이 좀 길긴 하지만 압도적인 세척력과 편리함, 깔끔한 디자인까지 만족스러운 제품입니다.  설거지 때문에 부부 싸움이 잦거나 퇴근 후 여유를 찾고 싶은 분이라면 무조건 추천 드립니다.  이 제품이 아니더라도 식기세척기 좋습니다..ㅎㅎㅎ  짧은 의견이지만 솔직하게 작성하였고 혹시라도 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 하단의 '도움이 돼요' 버튼을 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다~!

Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

한 번에 500g 인가 들어가고 한 번 넣으면 반년 정도 쓴다는 거 같은데 기억이 가물가물하네요... 큰 비용이 들어가는 건 아니지만 식세기 전용 세제, 린스, 해당 제품만의 소금까지... 추가적인 비용이 들어가는 점 참고하시면 좋을 거 같습니다.  2. 물 비린내 해당 제품 사용 시 식기류는 정말 깨끗한데 물 비린내(?) 같이 냄새가 조금 났습니다. 다른 식기세척기도 그런 건지 제가 이 제품으로 입문을 해서 모르겠지만 물 비린내가 난다는 점은 참고해 주시고 이걸 잡기 위해서 세제를 써줘야 한다는 거 같습니다. 저희는 지금 식세기 세제로 유명한 제품을 쓰고 있고 물 비린내가 없어졌습니다.  ■개인적인 생각■ 세척력 새 제품 세척 시 ★★★★★ 식사 후 그대로 세척 시  ★★☆☆☆ 식사 후 애벌 후 세척 시 ★★★★★  솔직하게 말씀드리자면 세척력에 대해 말씀드릴 부분이 많습니다. 처음에 새로운 그릇들과 냄비 등 식기류를 사 와서 세척기에 넣고 돌렸을 때 정말 신통방통했습니다. 굉장히 깔끔하게 세척이 되었고 뽀드득 소리까지 날 정도였으니 그러다 한 번은 집들이 후 대충 물로 헹군 뒤 세척을 돌렸고 다음 날 경악했습니다. 식기를 많이 넣어 그럴 수도 있겠지만 그릇 내부에 고춧가루, 밥풀 등등 제대로 세척이 되지 않았던 거죠... 그리고 요새는 물로 애벌 후 식세기를 돌리는데 그 결과는 천지차이로 정말 깨끗하게 잘 되니  어느 정도 애벌은 필요하다가 결론입니다.  여기서 애벌이라고 하면 많은 분들이 그럴 거면 손으로 하지 굳이 왜?라는 말씀을 많이 하시는데 저희도 저와 와이프 둘이 먹은 것은 손 설거지 합니다. 다만 손님들이 왔을 때 새 식기류를 샀을 때 그리고 약간의 귀찮음이 많아지는 그런 날 이 식세기가 큰 도움이 되기 때문에  저는 다시 돌아가도 무조건 식세기 구매합니다.  ■총평■ 해당 제품은 단순히 설거지라는 가사 노동을 대신해 주는 기계를 넘어 가족의 위생을 책임지고  퇴근 후 귀중한 개인 정비 시간을 돌려주는 '삶의 질 상승 아이템'입니다. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 초기 비용과 세척 시간이 좀 길긴 하지만 압도적인 세척력과 편리함, 깔끔한 디자인까지 만족스러운 제품입니다.  설거지 때문에 부부 싸움이 잦거나 퇴근 후 여유를 찾고 싶은 분이라면 무조건 추천 드립니다.  이 제품이 아니더라도 식기세척기 좋습니다..ㅎㅎㅎ  짧은 의견이지만 솔직하게 작성하였고 혹시라도 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 하단의 '도움이 돼요' 버튼을 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다~!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

한 번에 500g 인가 들어가고 한 번 넣으면 반년 정도 쓴다는 거 같은데 기억이 가물가물하네요... 큰 비용이 들어가는 건 아니지만 식세기 전용 세제, 린스, 해당 제품만의 소금까지... 추가적인 비용이 들어가는 점 참고하시면 좋을 거 같습니다.  2. 물 비린내 해당 제품 사용 시 식기류는 정말 깨끗한데 물 비린내(?) 같이 냄새가 조금 났습니다. 다른 식기세척기도 그런 건지 제가 이 제품으로 입문을 해서 모르겠지만 물 비린내가 난다는 점은 참고해 주시고 이걸 잡기 위해서 세제를 써줘야 한다는 거 같습니다. 저희는 지금 식세기 세제로 유명한 제품을 쓰고 있고 물 비린내가 없어졌습니다.  ■개인적인 생각■ 세척력 새 제품 세척 시 ★★★★★ 식사 후 그대로 세척 시  ★★☆☆☆ 식사 후 애벌 후 세척 시 ★★★★★  솔직하게 말씀드리자면 세척력에 대해 말씀드릴 부분이 많습니다. 처음에 새로운 그릇들과 냄비 등 식기류를 사 와서 세척기에 넣고 돌렸을 때 정말 신통방통했습니다. 굉장히 깔끔하게 세척이 되었고 뽀드득 소리까지 날 정도였으니 그러다 한 번은 집들이 후 대충 물로 헹군 뒤 세척을 돌렸고 다음 날 경악했습니다. 식기를 많이 넣어 그럴 수도 있겠지만 그릇 내부에 고춧가루, 밥풀 등등 제대로 세척이 되지 않았던 거죠... 그리고 요새는 물로 애벌 후 식세기를 돌리는데 그 결과는 천지차이로 정말 깨끗하게 잘 되니  어느 정도 애벌은 필요하다가 결론입니다.  여기서 애벌이라고 하면 많은 분들이 그럴 거면 손으로 하지 굳이 왜?라는 말씀을 많이 하시는데 저희도 저와 와이프 둘이 먹은 것은 손 설거지 합니다. 다만 손님들이 왔을 때 새 식기류를 샀을 때 그리고 약간의 귀찮음이 많아지는 그런 날 이 식세기가 큰 도움이 되기 때문에  저는 다시 돌아가도 무조건 식세기 구매합니다.  ■총평■ 해당 제품은 단순히 설거지라는 가사 노동을 대신해 주는 기계를 넘어 가족의 위생을 책임지고  퇴근 후 귀중한 개인 정비 시간을 돌려주는 '삶의 질 상승 아이템'입니다. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 초기 비용과 세척 시간이 좀 길긴 하지만 압도적인 세척력과 편리함, 깔끔한 디자인까지 만족스러운 제품입니다.  설거지 때문에 부부 싸움이 잦거나 퇴근 후 여유를 찾고 싶은 분이라면 무조건 추천 드립니다.  이 제품이 아니더라도 식기세척기 좋습니다..ㅎㅎㅎ  짧은 의견이지만 솔직하게 작성하였고 혹시라도 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 하단의 '도움이 돼요' 버튼을 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다~!
