Comments (English): [ #dishwasher #aunt #needs a larva but #best ] || ---------------- || Hello~~ This is "Honest Husband" who is trying to help you with your purchasing decisions. Before I start the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will be visiting the product and there will be an additional charge depending on the installation environment. You will also need to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the disposal sticker before putting them away.) I got the dishwasher I had been looking forward to when I moved into my new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will dramatically improve your quality of life, so I kept thinking that I absolutely had to get one when I moved in, and in the end, I did. Honestly, since it's just my wife and I, we don't need a large dishwasher right now and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wasn't sure if it was really necessary. However, we also have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly share my thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchasing decision. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000 Product Order Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 Product Received: Saturday, August 30, 2025 Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf: This large-capacity dishwasher can hold a lot of dishes. However, because the heights of the dishes are not all the same, it can be a bit of a challenge to place dishes and pots. You need to leave some space, and this smart shelf function allows you to adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Open: After washing, the door automatically opens to vent moisture inside, and the hot air drying function dries the dishes dry and fluffy. This is much more hygienic than natural drying, and it's convenient because you can take out the dishes right away. 3. Steam: This dishwasher sprays high-temperature steam during the wash cycle to remove harmful bacteria and viruses from the dishes. Thanks to this function, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready to use right away. 4. 10% Rebate: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but it's a good deal to get a 10% rebate if you're already buying. I applied after installation and already received the 10% discount. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance Costs: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the story. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, or refined salt (I think). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but I'd recommend adding it. You should, right? It holds about 500g, and I think one refill lasts about half a year, though I can't quite remember. It's not a huge expense, but it's worth noting that dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the product-specific salt are additional costs. 2. Fishy Smell: When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight fishy smell (like a fishy smell). I'm not sure if this applies to other dishwashers, but I'm new to this product, so please be aware of the fishy smell and use detergent to remove it. We're currently using a well-known dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. My personal thoughts on the cleaning power: When washing new dishes, when washing immediately after a meal, and after pre-washing after a meal. To be honest, there's a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and put them in the dishwasher, I was amazed. They cleaned incredibly well, and even made a squeaking noise. Then, after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and washed them. The next day, I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes weren't properly cleaned of things like chili powder and rice starch. These days, I pre-wash them with water and then run the dishwasher. The results are completely different, so I've concluded that pre-washing is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother with handwashing?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, this dishwasher is a huge help when guests come over, when I buy new dishes, and on days when things get a little more hectic. So, I would definitely buy it again. Overall Review: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for me. It's a "quality-of-life item" that takes care of my family's hygiene and gives me back precious time for personal care after work. While the initial cost and washing time may be a bit long, it offers impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently fights with their spouse over dishes or just wants to relax after work. Even if it's not this product, dishwashers are great. This review is short, but I've written it honestly. If you found this review helpful in your purchase, please click the "Helpful" button below!

한 번에 500g 인가 들어가고 한 번 넣으면 반년 정도 쓴다는 거 같은데 기억이 가물가물하네요... 큰 비용이 들어가는 건 아니지만 식세기 전용 세제, 린스, 해당 제품만의 소금까지... 추가적인 비용이 들어가는 점 참고하시면 좋을 거 같습니다.  2. 물 비린내 해당 제품 사용 시 식기류는 정말 깨끗한데 물 비린내(?) 같이 냄새가 조금 났습니다. 다른 식기세척기도 그런 건지 제가 이 제품으로 입문을 해서 모르겠지만 물 비린내가 난다는 점은 참고해 주시고 이걸 잡기 위해서 세제를 써줘야 한다는 거 같습니다. 저희는 지금 식세기 세제로 유명한 제품을 쓰고 있고 물 비린내가 없어졌습니다.  ■개인적인 생각■ 세척력 새 제품 세척 시 ★★★★★ 식사 후 그대로 세척 시  ★★☆☆☆ 식사 후 애벌 후 세척 시 ★★★★★  솔직하게 말씀드리자면 세척력에 대해 말씀드릴 부분이 많습니다. 처음에 새로운 그릇들과 냄비 등 식기류를 사 와서 세척기에 넣고 돌렸을 때 정말 신통방통했습니다. 굉장히 깔끔하게 세척이 되었고 뽀드득 소리까지 날 정도였으니 그러다 한 번은 집들이 후 대충 물로 헹군 뒤 세척을 돌렸고 다음 날 경악했습니다. 식기를 많이 넣어 그럴 수도 있겠지만 그릇 내부에 고춧가루, 밥풀 등등 제대로 세척이 되지 않았던 거죠... 그리고 요새는 물로 애벌 후 식세기를 돌리는데 그 결과는 천지차이로 정말 깨끗하게 잘 되니  어느 정도 애벌은 필요하다가 결론입니다.  여기서 애벌이라고 하면 많은 분들이 그럴 거면 손으로 하지 굳이 왜?라는 말씀을 많이 하시는데 저희도 저와 와이프 둘이 먹은 것은 손 설거지 합니다. 다만 손님들이 왔을 때 새 식기류를 샀을 때 그리고 약간의 귀찮음이 많아지는 그런 날 이 식세기가 큰 도움이 되기 때문에  저는 다시 돌아가도 무조건 식세기 구매합니다.  ■총평■ 해당 제품은 단순히 설거지라는 가사 노동을 대신해 주는 기계를 넘어 가족의 위생을 책임지고  퇴근 후 귀중한 개인 정비 시간을 돌려주는 '삶의 질 상승 아이템'입니다. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 초기 비용과 세척 시간이 좀 길긴 하지만 압도적인 세척력과 편리함, 깔끔한 디자인까지 만족스러운 제품입니다.  설거지 때문에 부부 싸움이 잦거나 퇴근 후 여유를 찾고 싶은 분이라면 무조건 추천 드립니다.  이 제품이 아니더라도 식기세척기 좋습니다..ㅎㅎㅎ  짧은 의견이지만 솔직하게 작성하였고 혹시라도 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 하단의 '도움이 돼요' 버튼을 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다~!

Comments (English): [ Since there are so many types of dishwashers, which one is better? ] || ---------------- || With so many dishwashers, I had a really hard time deciding which one to buy. Which brand to buy, and even within that brand, what features and functions should I choose? I had absolutely no idea. In the deluge of information, I was completely lost. To those struggling like me, I can only say, "Buy this! This product! Buy it!" That's the bottom line. I researched on YouTube, blogs, and even asked real users around me. After researching, I found that most people don't use steam or hot air dryers. (The common consensus among experienced users was that they only use the basic drying feature of hot air dryers due to the high electricity bill.) Most people only use them for washing and basic drying, so I wanted something that truly delivers on the basics. With a simple design and color that wouldn't detract from the aesthetics of their kitchen, this was the perfect fit. It's a product that delivers on the basics while also being incredibly cost-effective! With the Chuseok sale, it was even cheaper, so I couldn't resist. And since it's a Grade 1 product, I'm eligible for a 10% government rebate. After finalizing my purchase, I couldn't wait for delivery. And now that it's delivered and installed, wow! I'm so happy! First of all, it's so neat and pretty, and it blends seamlessly into my kitchen! The beige dishwasher pairs beautifully with the white sink. It's also easy and simple to use. Don't worry, it has a built-in drying function, even without steam or hot air drying. The dishwasher's operating and draining noises are surprisingly quiet. I was worried it would be noisy, but it was surprisingly quiet. It makes a water noise similar to a washing machine, but it's so much quieter that I keep checking to see if it's running smoothly. ^^;;. So, no worries about noise! There were two things that bothered me when I was considering buying this product. One was that the display was on the front, not the top. I prefer the top or the front. If you have a preference, that's probably the right choice. I didn't really have a preference, so I chose the top or front because I didn't think it would be too inconvenient. Yes, I'm not sure if it's inconvenient. The dishwasher seems to remember the settings by default. So, all I had to do was press the power button and the start button, so it was hassle-free. A friend of mine said having the buttons on the top was convenient, but I found the front one to be comfortable as well. Second, the two-tier tray was a bit concerning because some people said three-tier trays were more convenient. I was fine with the two-tier one, though. The clip at the top can be moved around. I was able to use it without any major issues. So, I'm extremely satisfied with the product. Finally, the most satisfying thing was the installer. I highly recommend him. (Technician Lee 0-ju! The best!). I highly recommend him for his after-sales service. I couldn't believe how gentle and sweet the installer was! Before the installation, he explained various things that could happen after the installation. "This may happen, is it okay? How about this? Could you look into this? If it's okay, I'll proceed." He was the type to ask me very detailed questions, explain things, and have a conversation. He was incredibly kind, humble, and polite. It was so helpful for us to learn so many useful tips about things that could happen in the future and things to watch out for. A neat and clean installation was a given. They were extremely careful to minimize any gaps between the sink and the unit. LG. I don't know how they train their technicians, but... I give them so much credit! I already only use LG appliances, and I will continue to use LG! LG is the best! The technician who came to our house and installed it was even better! The best! Thank you so much! Sentence (English): The dishwasher works fine, however the front of the dishwasher looks like it is stainless steel and it definitely is not.
Comments (English): [ What looks like a stainless steel front isn't stainless at all. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher works fine, however the front of the dishwasher looks like it is stainless steel and it definitely is not. My dishwasher is next to the sink, and after the first night after loading it, I woke up the next morning to find a steak of tiny rust spots left by a thin stream of water that had flowed off the counter overnight down the front of the dishwasher. They did not easily come out. It took an hour of scrubbing with soft scrub to make them partially disappear and they still can be seen in the right light. I contacted GE/ Haier, the makers, telling them what had happened and got back a long, very prepared reply, saying that a lot of people had encountered the same problem. Here is their reply, but the bottom line is don't order the faux-stainless steel model. If they have it in black, get that. As I said, the dishwasher works fine. Here is that email: Good morning,I would first like to thank you for contacting GE Appliances, a Haier Company with your concerns. We take all feedback very seriously and appreciate the opportunity you are giving us to assist you in this time of inconvenience. (Name of sender left out.) Stainless Steel is a slightly misleading name. A more accurate description would be Harder to Stain Steel. The largest single component of stainless steel is steel. Steel will rust. Especially around high humidity areas. The chromium in stainless steel when exposed to oxygen in the atmosphere forms a thin invisible layer called chromium oxide. This invisible layer covering the entire surface gives stainless steel its ability to resist stains and rust. If this layer is damaged rust is formed on the surface at the point of that damage. The good news is, with a little cleaning and care the chromium oxide layer is self-healing.Avoid damaging the chromium oxide layer by avoiding the use of cleaners that contain chlorides (fluorine, chlorine, bromine, iodine, etc.). Cleaners containing alcohol, ammonia or mineral spirits can also damage the protective layer. Do not use steel wool or steel brushes as minute particles of these carbon steel articles may adhere to the stainless and begin to rust. Avoid any caustic cleaners containing any of the above. If these compounds were to be used extreme care must be used to remove any and all traces of the cleaner as these chemicals damage the chromium oxide layer. Stainless steel and the chromium oxide layer actually thrive on proper cleaning. For everyday cleaning of non-oxidized soils, dust, dirt and fingerprints, a mild soap/detergent (dish detergent) and warm water solution should be used. Use the solution to remove the soil, rinsing with fresh water and a clean cloth, and dry completely. Another alternative is to clean with a recommended Stainless Steel Cleaner such as Stainless Steel Cleaner. For rust, tarnish, and small blemishes: Cleaners that contain Oxalic Acid, such as Bar Keepers Friend Soft Cleanser or Sheila Shine , will remove rust, tarnish, and small blemishes. Use only the liquid cleanser (free of grit) and be sure rub in the direction of the metal grain lines with a damp soft sponge. Another alternative to remove of oxidized stains and even “surface rust” can be done by using a paste made from baking soda and water. Using a cloth or soft bristle brush, rub the baking soda in the direction of the grain. This may take a little effort but this will remove these soils. When cleaned, rinse with clean water on a clean soft cloth. Next, apply a Stainless Steel cleaner and protectant. I hope these tips help you keep your stainless steel dishwasher looking new! Thank you for contacting GE Appliances, a Haier Company and I hope you have a wonderful day!

Sentence (English): I was looking to upgrade from a 6-seater to a 12-seater after moving, so I chose this product after careful consideration.
Comments (English): I was looking to upgrade from a 6-seater to a 12-seater after moving, so I chose this product after careful consideration. When I first used it, it had severe water stains, similar to other products, but the stains disappeared with use. I've used both the LG 12 and Samsung 6, and this one seems to have the same problem. Since it's just like that, it will disappear with use? Same. Sometimes, the dishes come out just after washing. Like a grease-stained lunch box. In this case, when you wash it, you can wipe it with a sponge and put it back in, and it will be cleaned thoroughly. As for the basket? Only the bottom part is detachable, so when you put dishes in the top, water leaks onto the bottom, which is inconvenient. It comes off, but I don't want to take it out because it seems like it would be harder to put the dishes in and put them back in. It doesn't come off. There's a separate cutlery holder, so when there aren't many dishes, you can just swirl the bottom one around for easy use. There's an additional drying function, but since I leave it until it's completely dry anyway, it's not inconvenient now. At first, I was using a Samsung 6-person model, and I was disappointed because there was so much moisture that I wondered if it wasn't drying properly. But I got used to it as I used it. When I wash the Samsung model, I hear a whirling sound like a whirlwind, so I know it's washing, but this one just makes the sound of water. Still, I'm 80% satisfied. It can be controlled with an app. I always think it's lacking, but I think it's a good deal for a 12-person model at this price. I'll come back with more photos and a review if I think of it.

Before the review, I would like to inform you that an LG technician will come to install the product, and depending on the installation environment, there will be an additional fee, and you will have to dispose of the lower cabinets that come out of the sink yourself. (Attach the waste sticker before putting it away.) I bought the dishwasher that I had been looking forward to so much when I moved into a new house at the end of August. I heard that it is one of the three dishwashers that will vertically improve your quality of life, and I kept thinking that I absolutely had to buy one when I moved, and in the end, I did buy it. Honestly, right now, it's just my wife and I, so we don't need a big product, and we don't have enough dishes to wash using a dishwasher, so I wondered if it was really necessary. However, we have a housewarming party and we like to have drinks with friends, so I thought it would be convenient to have one, so I bought it. I will honestly tell you what I felt after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope it helps with your purchase. Product purchase price 1,078,000 Product order date 2025. 8. 21 (Thu)Product receipt date 2025. 8. 30 (Sat)Product advantages 1. Smart shelf First of all, it is a large-capacity dishwasher that can hold a lot of tableware. However, since the heights of the tableware are not all the same, it takes a bit of Tetris when putting in dishes or pots. You need to leave some space, and in that case, you can adjust the height with this smart shelf function to secure space. 2. Automatic door opening After washing is finished, the door automatically opens to discharge the moisture inside, and the hot air drying function is added to dry the dishes softly without moisture. It is much more hygienic than the natural drying method, and it is convenient because you can take out the dishes right away and use them. 3. It is said that the high-temperature steam is sprayed during the steam cleaning process to remove harmful bacteria and viruses attached to the dishes. Thanks to this function, there are fewer water stains and the dishes are ready to use. 4. 10% Refund: 10% rebates are all the rage these days, and I'm not sure when they'll all run out, but since I'm already buying it, I think it's a good idea to get a 10% rebate. I applied after installation and already received the 10%. Product Disadvantages: 1. Maintenance: Purchasing a product isn't the end of the deal. For this product, you need to add dishwasher-specific salt, like refined salt (?). It seems like it's possible to use it without it, but it's recommended. You should add it, right? I think it goes in 500g at a time, and once you add it, it should last about six months, but I can't remember exactly. It's not a huge expense, but you need dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and salt specifically for the product. Please keep in mind that this incurs additional costs. 2. Fishy water smell: The dishware was really clean, but it had a slight fishy smell (?). I don't know if other dishwashers have the same problem, but since I'm just starting out with this product, please keep in mind that there's a fishy smell. I think you need to use detergent to get rid of it. We're currently using a famous dishwasher detergent, and the fishy smell has disappeared. Personal thoughts: Cleaning power: When washing a new product, when washing right after a meal, when washing after a meal To be honest, I have a lot to say about the cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes and pots and put them in the dishwasher and ran them, I was amazed. They washed very cleanly and even made a squeaking sound. Then, one time after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and ran the wash, and the next day I was shocked. It could be because I put a lot of dishes in them, but the inside of the dishes had not been properly cleaned of chili powder, rice starch, etc. These days, I use the dishwasher after washing with water. The results are incredibly clean, so I've concluded that washing with water is necessary. Many people say, "If you're going to do that, why bother doing it by hand?" My wife and I both wash our dishes by hand. However, the dishwasher is incredibly helpful when we have guests, when we buy new dishes, or when things get a little more hectic. So, I'd definitely buy one again. Overall: This product goes beyond simply doing the dishes for you. It's a "quality-of-life item," ensuring your family's hygiene and giving you back precious time for personal grooming after work. While the initial cost and washing time are a bit long, it's incredibly satisfying, offering impressive cleaning power, convenience, and a clean design. If you frequently fight with your spouse over the dishes or just want to relax after work, I highly recommend it. Even if this isn't your first choice, you can still get a good dishwasher. Personal thoughts: Cleaning power: When washing a new product, when washing right after a meal, when washing after a meal To be honest, I have a lot to say about the cleaning power. Sentence (English): I decided to upgrade from a 6-seater to a 12-seater after moving, and after careful consideration, I chose this product.
Comments (English): I decided to upgrade from a 6-seater to a 12-seater after moving, and after careful consideration, I chose this product. When I first used it, it had severe water stains, similar to other products, but the stains fade with use. I've used both the LG 12 and Samsung 6, and this one seems to have the same problem. It's just the way it is, so it will disappear with use, right? Sometimes, the dishes come out clean, like the grease-stained side dish container. In these cases, I just wipe it with a sponge and put it back in the dishwasher before washing. As for the basket? Only the bottom part is detachable, so when I put dishes in the top part, water spills onto the bottom, which is inconvenient. It can be removed, but I don't want to remove it because it would be harder to put the dishes in and replace them. There's a separate cutlery holder, so when I don't have many dishes, I just use the bottom part. It's easy to use because I can just turn it. There is an additional drying function, but since I leave it until it dries completely anyway, it's not inconvenient now. At first, I was disappointed because there was so much moisture that I wondered if it wasn't drying well when I used the Samsung 6-person model. But I got used to it as I used it. When I wash the Samsung model, I can hear a whirling sound like water, so I know it's washing properly. But with this one, I just hear the sound of water. Still, I'm 80% satisfied. It can also be controlled through an app. I always think it's lacking, but I think it's a good deal for a 12-person model at this price. I'll come back with more photos and a review if I think of it.

Before the review, please note that an LG technician will visit for this product. There may be an additional fee depending on the installation environment, and you must dispose of the base cabinet removed from the sink yourself (attach a waste sticker and put it out). Moving into our new house at the end of August, we finally brought home the dishwasher we had been eagerly anticipating. I heard it is one of the "top three appliances" that supposedly dramatically improve quality of life. I kept telling myself I absolutely had to buy one after moving, and in the end, I really did. Honestly, since it is just my wife and me in the family right now, I didn't think we needed a large product, nor do we produce enough dishes to require a dishwasher to wash. I wondered if it was really necessary, but we have a housewarming party coming up, and since we really enjoy drinking with friends, I decided to buy it thinking it would definitely be convenient to have. I will share my honest thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope this helps with your purchase. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000. Product Order Date: August 21, 2025 (Thu). Product Receipt Date: August 30, 2025 (Sat). Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf. First of all, as a large-capacity dishwasher, it fits a lot of tableware. However, since the heights of the dishes are not all the same, a bit of Tetris is required when loading bowls or pots. You also need to leave some space. That is where this smart shelf function comes in; you can adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Opening. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to release internal moisture. Combined with a hot air drying function, it dries the dishes to a fluffy, water-free state. It is much more hygienic than natural drying and convenient because you can take the dishes out and use them immediately. 3. Steam. It is said that high-temperature steam is sprayed during the wash process to remove harmful bacteria and viruses attached to the dishes. Perhaps thanks to this feature, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready for immediate use. 4. 10% Cashback. The 10% cashback is very popular these days. I'm not sure when the funds will run out and the promotion will end, but since you're buying it anyway, I think it's good that you can get a 10% cashback. I applied after installation, so I've already received the 10%. Product downsides: 1. Maintenance costs. Purchasing the product isn't the end of it. For this model, you need to add what seems to be refined salt (?), or rather, salt specifically designed for dishwashers. It seems you can use it without it, but since they recommend adding it, I suppose I should. It takes about 500g at a time, and I think one serving lasts about six months, though my memory is a bit hazy. It isn't a huge expense, but please keep in mind that there are additional costs for dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the salt unique to this product. 2. Fishy water smell. When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight smell, like fishy water (?). I don't know if other dishwashers are like this since this is my first time using this model, but please be aware that there is a fishy water smell. It seems you need to use detergent to get rid of it. We are currently using a product famous for dishwasher detergent, and the musty smell in the water has disappeared. My personal opinion: cleaning power. When washing new items; when washing directly after a meal; and when washing after pre-washing. To be honest, there is a lot to say regarding cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes, pots, and other tableware and put them in the dishwasher, it was truly amazing. They cleaned very thoroughly, to the point where they even squeaked. Then, one time after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and ran the wash cycle. The next day, I was horrified. It might have been because I put a lot of dishes in, but the inside of the dishes—red pepper flakes, rice grains, etc.—had not been properly cleaned. These days, however, I pre-wash with water before running the dishwasher, and the results are worlds apart; they clean really well. So, the conclusion is that some degree of pre-washing is necessary. When I mention pre-washing, many people ask, "If that's the case, why bother? Just wash by hand." My wife and I also hand-wash dishes after we've eaten. However, when guests come over or when we've bought new tableware... And on those days when a bit of a hassle piles up, this dishwasher is a huge help. That is why, even if I could go back in time, I would definitely buy a dishwasher. Overall Review: This product is more than just a machine that takes over the household chore of washing dishes. It is a "quality-enhancing item" that takes responsibility for family hygiene and gives back precious personal grooming time after work. Although the initial cost and wash time are a bit long, it is a satisfying product with overwhelming cleaning power, convenience, and a sleek design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently argues with their spouse over dishwashing or wants to find some free time after work. Even if it isn't this specific model, dishwashers are good. I don't know if other dishwashers are like this since this is my first time using this model, but please be aware that there is a fishy water smell. It takes about 500g at a time, and I think one serving lasts about six months, though my memory is a bit hazy. When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight smell, like fishy water (?). I don't know if other dishwashers are like this since this is my first time using this model, but please be aware that there is a fishy water smell. It seems you need to use detergent to get rid of it. We are currently using a product famous for dishwasher detergent, and the musty smell in the water has disappeared. It might have been because I put a lot of dishes in, but the inside of the dishes—red pepper flakes, rice grains, etc.—had not been properly cleaned. These days, however, I pre-wash with water before running the dishwasher, and the results are worlds apart; they clean really well. So, the conclusion is that some degree of pre-washing is necessary. When I mention pre-washing, many people ask, "If that's the case, why bother? Just wash by hand." My wife and I also hand-wash dishes after we've eaten. However, when guests come over or when we've bought new tableware... And on those days when a bit of a hassle piles up, this dishwasher is a huge help. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently argues with their spouse over dishwashing or wants to find some free time after work. Even if it isn't this specific model, dishwashers are good. It might have been because I put a lot of dishes in, but the inside of the dishes—red pepper flakes, rice grains, etc.—had not been properly cleaned. Comments (English): [ #Dishwasher #Auntie #Pre-washingisnecessarybut #Thebest ] || ---------------- || Hello~~. This is "Honest Husband," striving to help you with your purchases. Before the review, please note that an LG technician will visit for this product. There may be an additional fee depending on the installation environment, and you must dispose of the base cabinet removed from the sink yourself (attach a waste sticker and put it out). Moving into our new house at the end of August, we finally brought home the dishwasher we had been eagerly anticipating. I heard it is one of the "top three appliances" that supposedly dramatically improve quality of life. I kept telling myself I absolutely had to buy one after moving, and in the end, I really did. Honestly, since it is just my wife and me in the family right now, I didn't think we needed a large product, nor do we produce enough dishes to require a dishwasher to wash. I wondered if it was really necessary, but we have a housewarming party coming up, and since we really enjoy drinking with friends, I decided to buy it thinking it would definitely be convenient to have. I will share my honest thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope this helps with your purchase. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000. Product Order Date: August 21, 2025 (Thu). Product Receipt Date: August 30, 2025 (Sat). Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf. First of all, as a large-capacity dishwasher, it fits a lot of tableware. However, since the heights of the dishes are not all the same, a bit of Tetris is required when loading bowls or pots. You also need to leave some space. That is where this smart shelf function comes in; you can adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Opening. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to release internal moisture. Combined with a hot air drying function, it dries the dishes to a fluffy, water-free state. It is much more hygienic than natural drying and convenient because you can take the dishes out and use them immediately. 3. Steam. It is said that high-temperature steam is sprayed during the wash process to remove harmful bacteria and viruses attached to the dishes. Perhaps thanks to this feature, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready for immediate use. 4. 10% Cashback. The 10% cashback is very popular these days. I'm not sure when the funds will run out and the promotion will end, but since you're buying it anyway, I think it's good that you can get a 10% cashback. I applied after installation, so I've already received the 10%. Product downsides: 1. Maintenance costs. Purchasing the product isn't the end of it. For this model, you need to add what seems to be refined salt (?), or rather, salt specifically designed for dishwashers. It seems you can use it without it, but since they recommend adding it, I suppose I should. It takes about 500g at a time, and I think one serving lasts about six months, though my memory is a bit hazy. It isn't a huge expense, but please keep in mind that there are additional costs for dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the salt unique to this product. 2. Fishy water smell. When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight smell, like fishy water (?). I don't know if other dishwashers are like this since this is my first time using this model, but please be aware that there is a fishy water smell. It seems you need to use detergent to get rid of it. We are currently using a product famous for dishwasher detergent, and the musty smell in the water has disappeared. My personal opinion: cleaning power. When washing new items; when washing directly after a meal; and when washing after pre-washing. To be honest, there is a lot to say regarding cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes, pots, and other tableware and put them in the dishwasher, it was truly amazing. They cleaned very thoroughly, to the point where they even squeaked. Then, one time after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and ran the wash cycle. The next day, I was horrified. It might have been because I put a lot of dishes in, but the inside of the dishes—red pepper flakes, rice grains, etc.—had not been properly cleaned. These days, however, I pre-wash with water before running the dishwasher, and the results are worlds apart; they clean really well. So, the conclusion is that some degree of pre-washing is necessary. When I mention pre-washing, many people ask, "If that's the case, why bother? Just wash by hand." My wife and I also hand-wash dishes after we've eaten. However, when guests come over or when we've bought new tableware... And on those days when a bit of a hassle piles up, this dishwasher is a huge help. That is why, even if I could go back in time, I would definitely buy a dishwasher. Overall Review: This product is more than just a machine that takes over the household chore of washing dishes. It is a "quality-enhancing item" that takes responsibility for family hygiene and gives back precious personal grooming time after work. Although the initial cost and wash time are a bit long, it is a satisfying product with overwhelming cleaning power, convenience, and a sleek design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently argues with their spouse over dishwashing or wants to find some free time after work. Even if it isn't this specific model, dishwashers are good. I wrote this brief but honest opinion. If it was helpful to your purchase decision, please let me know. I would appreciate it if you could click the "Helpful" button at the bottom!

There may be an additional fee depending on the installation environment, and you must dispose of the base cabinet removed from the sink yourself (attach a waste sticker and put it out). Moving into our new house at the end of August, we finally brought home the dishwasher we had been eagerly anticipating. I heard it is one of the "top three appliances" that supposedly dramatically improve quality of life. I kept telling myself I absolutely had to buy one after moving, and in the end, I really did. Honestly, since it is just my wife and me in the family right now, I didn't think we needed a large product, nor do we produce enough dishes to require a dishwasher to wash. I wondered if it was really necessary, but we have a housewarming party coming up, and since we really enjoy drinking with friends, I decided to buy it thinking it would definitely be convenient to have. I will share my honest thoughts after using it for about a month and a half, so I hope this helps with your purchase. Product Purchase Price: 1,078,000. Product Order Date: August 21, 2025 (Thu). Product Receipt Date: August 30, 2025 (Sat). Product Advantages: 1. Smart Shelf. First of all, as a large-capacity dishwasher, it fits a lot of tableware. However, since the heights of the dishes are not all the same, a bit of Tetris is required when loading bowls or pots. You also need to leave some space. That is where this smart shelf function comes in; you can adjust the height to secure space. 2. Automatic Door Opening. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to release internal moisture. Combined with a hot air drying function, it dries the dishes to a fluffy, water-free state. It is much more hygienic than natural drying and convenient because you can take the dishes out and use them immediately. 3. Steam. It is said that high-temperature steam is sprayed during the wash process to remove harmful bacteria and viruses attached to the dishes. Perhaps thanks to this feature, water stains are minimal, and the dishes are ready for immediate use. 4. 10% Cashback. The 10% cashback is very popular these days. I'm not sure when the funds will run out and the promotion will end, but since you're buying it anyway, I think it's good that you can get a 10% cashback. I applied after installation, so I've already received the 10%. Product downsides: 1. Maintenance costs. Purchasing the product isn't the end of it. For this model, you need to add what seems to be refined salt (?), or rather, salt specifically designed for dishwashers. It seems you can use it without it, but since they recommend adding it, I suppose I should. It takes about 500g at a time, and I think one serving lasts about six months, though my memory is a bit hazy. It isn't a huge expense, but please keep in mind that there are additional costs for dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and the salt unique to this product. 2. Fishy water smell. When using this product, the dishes were really clean, but there was a slight smell, like fishy water (?). I don't know if other dishwashers are like this since this is my first time using this model, but please be aware that there is a fishy water smell. It seems you need to use detergent to get rid of it. We are currently using a product famous for dishwasher detergent, and the musty smell in the water has disappeared. My personal opinion: cleaning power. When washing new items; when washing directly after a meal; and when washing after pre-washing. To be honest, there is a lot to say regarding cleaning power. When I first bought new dishes, pots, and other tableware and put them in the dishwasher, it was truly amazing. They cleaned very thoroughly, to the point where they even squeaked. Then, one time after a housewarming party, I roughly rinsed them with water and ran the wash cycle. The next day, I was horrified. It might have been because I put a lot of dishes in, but the inside of the dishes—red pepper flakes, rice grains, etc.—had not been properly cleaned. These days, however, I pre-wash with water before running the dishwasher, and the results are worlds apart; they clean really well. So, the conclusion is that some degree of pre-washing is necessary. When I mention pre-washing, many people ask, "If that's the case, why bother? Just wash by hand." My wife and I also hand-wash dishes after we've eaten. However, when guests come over or when we've bought new tableware... And on those days when a bit of a hassle piles up, this dishwasher is a huge help. That is why, even if I could go back in time, I would definitely buy a dishwasher. Overall Review: This product is more than just a machine that takes over the household chore of washing dishes. It is a "quality-enhancing item" that takes responsibility for family hygiene and gives back precious personal grooming time after work. Although the initial cost and wash time are a bit long, it is a satisfying product with overwhelming cleaning power, convenience, and a sleek design. I highly recommend it to anyone who frequently argues with their spouse over dishwashing or wants to find some free time after work. Even if it isn't this specific model, dishwashers are good. Sentence (English): After moving, we decided to upgrade from a 6-person to a 12-person model.
Comments (English): After moving, we decided to upgrade from a 6-person to a 12-person model. After much searching, we chose this product. When I first used it, it left severe water stains, similar to other products. However, the water stains disappear with continued use. I have used LG 12-person and Samsung 6-person models, and this one seems to have the same issue. It feels like it's just supposed to be like that and will disappear with use. Sometimes, dishes come out unwashed, like grease stains on food containers. In these cases, if I scrub them with a scouring pad during the pre-wash, they come out clean. The basket? Only the bottom part detaches, so it is inconvenient because water spills onto the floor when loading dishes or putting them in the top section. It does come off, but I don't take it out because it seems like it would be harder to put it back on after putting dishes in... so I can't remove it. Since there is a separate cutlery holder, it is convenient to just quickly rotate the bottom section when there aren't many dishes. Although it has an additional drying function, it isn't inconvenient right now since I just leave it until it's completely dry anyway. However, having used a Samsung 6-place setting before, I was initially disappointed because there was so much water that I even suspected it hadn't dried properly. But I've gotten used to it over time. With the Samsung, you could hear a swirling "whoosh" sound during the wash cycle, so I knew it was cleaning. With this one... you just hear the sound of water. Still, I'm 80% satisfied. It can also be controlled via the app. I always feel like it's lacking something, but considering it's a 12-place setting at this price, I think it's a great deal. I'll come back to add more photos and reviews if I remember. ----------------------. Review after using it for a while. Now that I've gotten used to it and it feels smoother, both the bottom and top sections of the dish basket are detachable. As for the water, just leaving it on allows it to dry reasonably well, which is good. It dries well and washes well. However, it feels a bit stiff when taking the basket out and putting it back in. It isn't smooth.

I have used LG 12-person and Samsung 6-person models, and this one seems to have the same issue. It feels like it's just supposed to be like that and will disappear with use. Sometimes, dishes come out unwashed, like grease stains on food containers. In these cases, if I scrub them with a scouring pad during the pre-wash, they come out clean. The basket? Only the bottom part detaches, so it is inconvenient because water spills onto the floor when loading dishes or putting them in the top section. It does come off, but I don't take it out because it seems like it would be harder to put it back on after putting dishes in... so I can't remove it. Since there is a separate cutlery holder, it is convenient to just quickly rotate the bottom section when there aren't many dishes. Although it has an additional drying function, it isn't inconvenient right now since I just leave it until it's completely dry anyway. However, having used a Samsung 6-place setting before, I was initially disappointed because there was so much water that I even suspected it hadn't dried properly. But I've gotten used to it over time. With the Samsung, you could hear a swirling "whoosh" sound during the wash cycle, so I knew it was cleaning. With this one... you just hear the sound of water. Still, I'm 80% satisfied. It can also be controlled via the app. I always feel like it's lacking something, but considering it's a 12-place setting at this price, I think it's a great deal. I'll come back to add more photos and reviews if I remember. ----------------------. Review after using it for a while. Now that I've gotten used to it and it feels smoother, both the bottom and top sections of the dish basket are detachable. As for the water, just leaving it on allows it to dry reasonably well, which is good. It dries well and washes well. However, it feels a bit stiff when taking the basket out and putting it back in. It isn't smooth.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher works fine, however the front of the dishwasher looks like it is stainless steel and it definitely is not.
Comments (English): [ What looks like a stainless steel front isn't stainless at all. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher works fine, however the front of the dishwasher looks like it is stainless steel and it definitely is not. My dishwasher is next to the sink, and after the first night after loading it, I woke up the next morning to find a steak of tiny rust spots left by a thin stream of water that had flowed off the counter overnight down the front of the dishwasher. They did not easily come out. It took an hour of scrubbing with soft scrub to make them partially disappear and they still can be seen in the right light. I contacted GE/ Haier, the makers, telling them what had happened and got back a long, very prepared reply, saying that a lot of people had encountered the same problem. Here is their reply, but the bottom line is don't order the faux-stainless steel model. If they have it in black, get that. As I said, the dishwasher works fine. Here is that email: Good morning,. I would first like to thank you for contacting GE Appliances, a Haier Company with your concerns. We take all feedback very seriously and appreciate the opportunity you are giving us to assist you in this time of inconvenience. (Name of sender left out.) Stainless Steel is a slightly misleading name. A more accurate description would be Harder to Stain Steel. The largest single component of stainless steel is steel. Steel will rust. Especially around high humidity areas. The chromium in stainless steel when exposed to oxygen in the atmosphere forms a thin invisible layer called chromium oxide. This invisible layer covering the entire surface gives stainless steel its ability to resist stains and rust. If this layer is damaged rust is formed on the surface at the point of that damage. The good news is, with a little cleaning and care the chromium oxide layer is self-healing. Avoid damaging the chromium oxide layer by avoiding the use of cleaners that contain chlorides (fluorine, chlorine, bromine, iodine, etc.). Cleaners containing alcohol, ammonia or mineral spirits can also damage the protective layer. Do not use steel wool or steel brushes as minute particles of these carbon steel articles may adhere to the stainless and begin to rust. Avoid any caustic cleaners containing any of the above. If these compounds were to be used extreme care must be used to remove any and all traces of the cleaner as these chemicals damage the chromium oxide layer. Stainless steel and the chromium oxide layer actually thrive on proper cleaning. For everyday cleaning of non-oxidized soils, dust, dirt and fingerprints, a mild soap/detergent (dish detergent) and warm water solution should be used. Use the solution to remove the soil, rinsing with fresh water and a clean cloth, and dry completely. Another alternative is to clean with a recommended Stainless Steel Cleaner such as Stainless Steel Cleaner. For rust, tarnish, and small blemishes: Cleaners that contain Oxalic Acid, such as Bar Keepers Friend Soft Cleanser or Sheila Shine , will remove rust, tarnish, and small blemishes. Use only the liquid cleanser (free of grit) and be sure rub in the direction of the metal grain lines with a damp soft sponge. Another alternative to remove of oxidized stains and even “surface rust” can be done by using a paste made from baking soda and water. Using a cloth or soft bristle brush, rub the baking soda in the direction of the grain. This may take a little effort but this will remove these soils. When cleaned, rinse with clean water on a clean soft cloth. Next, apply a Stainless Steel cleaner and protectant. I hope these tips help you keep your stainless steel dishwasher looking new! Thank you for contacting GE Appliances, a Haier Company and I hope you have a wonderful day!

Sentence (English): Samsung Bespoke Dishwasher 6-Person DW30CB300CE0 One-Month Review: At first, I wondered if I really needed a dishwasher, but after using it for a month, I'm not sure why I bought it so soon.
Comments (English): [ Clean cleaning power and stylish design, a kitchen essential ] || ---------------- || Samsung Bespoke Dishwasher 6-Person DW30CB300CE0 One-Month Review: At first, I wondered if I really needed a dishwasher, but after using it for a month, I'm not sure why I bought it so soon. The auto-open drying feature is especially useful. After washing, the door opens slightly to let moisture escape, reducing water stains and eliminating odors. I'm also very satisfied with the cleaning performance. It thoroughly cleaned even burnt rice bowls, glasses, and cutlery. Perhaps because it washes directly with high-temperature water, there was almost no oil residue. I even washed baby bottles, and they came out clean and odorless, giving me peace of mind about hygiene. The design is also really pretty. The beige tempered glass panel blends well with my kitchen décor, and the touchscreen controls are easy to use. It's also small for a 6-person dishwasher, making it easy to place on the counter. However, the drying performance isn't 100% perfect. Some water droplets remain on plastic containers and deep cups. And the range of cycles isn't very diverse, so I mostly use the standard, heavy, and rapid cycles. Still, I'm satisfied with the cleaning power, hygiene, and design, so I recommend it overall. Pros: Automatic door opening, drying, virtually no moisture or odor, high-temperature sterilization cleaning, even for baby bottles, sophisticated bespoke design, quiet operation. Cons: Plastic dishes leave a little water droplets, and there aren't many cycle options. Overall: A small but powerful dishwasher! I'm satisfied with both the cleaning power and design, but the drying power is a bit disappointing.

My dishwasher was old and lacking in cleaning capabilities, so I was looking for a dishwasher with the same capacity. This product appeared at the top of the list. The price seemed reasonable, and since it was a Samsung product with a quick installation, I bought it without hesitation. However, after installation, when I tried to register it with SmartThings, it didn't register because it didn't have a Wi-Fi module. Then, I stumbled upon a Q&A thread and discovered that there was a separate version of the same product from August 2025. So I searched Coupang with "2025" in the search bar, but it didn't show up. While Samsung's official website and other stores show products manufactured this year at the top, Coupang only shows models manufactured in 2023, perhaps to clear out existing stock. Most importantly, the price difference between the official website and other stores is within 100,000 won for models with or without a hot air dryer. Of course, the difference in performance may not be huge (I haven't used it yet), but it would have been nice if the details page had clearly indicated to buyers that the product is a 23-year-old model. Although it is listed in the specs at the bottom, the image composition of the details pages for the 23-year-old and 25-year-old models is almost identical, and only the last digit of the model number is different, so I think there will be many people like me unless buyers look very carefully. This opportunity has taught me that you should at least compare and confirm home appliances in multiple places. I think I blindly trusted Coupang too much. This was the most regrettable purchase I've made in recent times, and this is my first time leaving a review. I'm leaving this review so that those of you who are thinking of buying home appliances can check in multiple places in case there is a renewal for the same product, and avoid the experience I had.

Comments (English): [ It's a shame that information about product renewal isn't noticeable. ] || ---------------- || I've always used Coupang as my top choice for all my purchases. My dishwasher was old and lacking in cleaning capabilities, so I was looking for a dishwasher with the same capacity. This product appeared at the top of the list. The price seemed reasonable, and since it was a Samsung product with a quick installation, I bought it without hesitation. However, after installation, when I tried to register it with SmartThings, it didn't register because it didn't have a Wi-Fi module. Then, I stumbled upon a Q&A thread and discovered that there was a separate version of the same product from August 2025. So I searched Coupang with "2025" in the search bar, but it didn't show up. While Samsung's official website and other stores show products manufactured this year at the top, Coupang only shows models manufactured in 2023, perhaps to clear out existing stock. Most importantly, the price difference between the official website and other stores is within 100,000 won for models with or without a hot air dryer. Of course, the difference in performance may not be huge (I haven't used it yet), but it would have been nice if the details page had clearly indicated to buyers that the product is a 23-year-old model. Although it is listed in the specs at the bottom, the image composition of the details pages for the 23-year-old and 25-year-old models is almost identical, and only the last digit of the model number is different, so I think there will be many people like me unless buyers look very carefully. This opportunity has taught me that you should at least compare and confirm home appliances in multiple places. I think I blindly trusted Coupang too much. This was the most regrettable purchase I've made in recent times, and this is my first time leaving a review. I'm leaving this review so that those of you who are thinking of buying home appliances can check in multiple places in case there is a renewal for the same product, and avoid the experience I had.

Sentence (English): I really like this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Fantastic and Quiet Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I really like this dishwasher. It's better than the previous Maytag that I owned for quite a few reasons.One is the top rack. The silverware rack (or at least I think that's what it is for). It removes the necessity of the basket that usually sits on the bottom rack and separates it entirely. Of course, the basket is still included, but I honestly don't have it in my dishwasher at current time.Two is that it quite frankly has a lot of capacity. I'm able to fit a surprising amount of dishes into this dang thing and have it run effectively. Part of this is because of the aforementioned silverware rack. Means I can remove the basket and just have that much more space for random dishes and/or cookware.Three is that this dishwasher is surprisingly quiet. I was expecting it to be noisy just like every other dishwasher I've used, but it isn't. You can obviously still hear it, but it's not loud at all. Both of the folks that I live with remarked this when I ran it for the first time.Fourth is its ability great ability to wash stuff. Everything has come out very clean since I've bought this. No residue, nothing. The only downside here is that it doesn't have an inbuilt food grinder, so you definitely have to scrape off dishes before using it, but who doesn't do that? Barbarians (and probably small children), that's who.Moving away from that, this dishwasher has SmartThings functionality, but I'm honestly at a loss for how this particular functionality can actually be useful in any sense. I'm not entirely certain why anyone would need to control their dishwasher remotely. I guess for the laziest of the laziest or those with mansions? Idk, seems like a waste of design time for R&D.Overall, this is a great dishwasher that functions exquisitely and has the capacity to make life easy. I highly recommend it and wish that my last dishwasher was a Samsung. Quite frankly, I didn't think a dishwasher could function quite this well.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher because my previous one broke down.
Comments (English): [ It's my own money. This beige dishwasher is luxurious! ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher because my previous one broke down. My parents always had a hard time washing dishes by hand, so I decided to buy them a better product as a gift. I compared several brands, and considering design, performance, and after-sales service, I was most satisfied with the LG Objet Collection. My first impression after installation was, as expected from LG, its sophisticated and luxurious design. The Objet Collection's signature muted colors and sleek built-in design gave the kitchen a much more sophisticated feel. The clean, handle-less finish blends perfectly with the other appliances, and my parents loved how it made their kitchen feel like a hotel. I'm also very satisfied with its performance. The cleaning power is definitely powerful. It leaves no residue, and even glassware comes out sparkling clean. It even cleans greasy frying pans and pots so thoroughly that my parents say they no longer have to do dishes. The door opens automatically after each wash, allowing the residual heat to dry the appliance, eliminating stains and odors. It's also incredibly quiet. The previous model was quite noisy, but this one is so quiet you won't even notice it's running, so you can use it even at night without any problems. It's spacious enough for 12 people, making it perfect for a large family. It's convenient because you can load pots, plates, and glasses all at once, and the internal tray is height-adjustable, allowing for dishes of various sizes. However, the two-tiered rack structure makes it a bit tricky to stand up large plates. The plate holders are so close together that I had to slightly twist the direction to place larger dishes. It took some getting used to at first, but after a few uses, I got the hang of it and now use it without any major issues. Cons: The two-tiered rack structure makes it difficult to arrange large plates or bowls. The plate holders are a bit too close together. Overall: This was a great choice as a gift for my parents. The design, cleaning power, and quietness are all satisfactory, and it's completely reduced their dishwashing burden. The satisfaction you gain far outweighs the minor inconveniences, and it's even transformed the kitchen atmosphere. This is the ultimate filial piety appliance, combining practicality and luxury.

It's disappointing to see a company dismiss a legitimate defect that impacts performance.If you're considering this model, I strongly urge you to look elsewhere. Comments (English): [ Clean cleaning power and stylish design, a kitchen essential ] || ---------------- || One-Month Review of the Samsung Bespoke Dishwasher DW30CB300CE0 (6-Place Capacity). At first, I wondered if I really needed a dishwasher, but after using it, I regret not buying it sooner. The automatic door-opening drying function is particularly useful. After the wash cycle is finished, the door opens slightly to let internal moisture escape; thanks to this, water stains are reduced and there is almost no odor. The cleaning performance is also satisfactory. It cleans everything perfectly, from bowls with burnt rice stuck to them, to glass cups and cutlery. Perhaps because it uses high-temperature direct water washing, there was almost no grease residue left behind. I even tried washing baby bottles, and they came out clean and odorless, giving me peace of mind regarding hygiene. The design is also really pretty. The beige tempered glass panel blends well with the kitchen atmosphere, and the touch controls provide a sleek user experience. It is also compact for a 6-place capacity dishwasher, so it fits well on the countertop. However, the drying performance isn't 100% perfect. Plastic containers and deep cups still retain a few water droplets. Also, since the cycles aren't very diverse, I mainly end up using only the Standard, Powerful, and Quick cycles. Nevertheless, I am satisfied with the cleaning power, hygiene, and design, so it is a product worth recommending overall. Pros: Almost no moisture or odor thanks to the automatic door-opening drying feature. High-temperature sterilization wash suitable for baby bottles. Sophisticated bespoke design. Not too noisy. Cons: Small water droplets remain on plastic dishes. Limited cycle options. Overall: A small but powerful dishwasher! Satisfied with both cleaning power and design, only the drying power is slightly lacking.

Sentence (English): I really like this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Fantastic and Quiet Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I really like this dishwasher. It's better than the previous Maytag that I owned for quite a few reasons. One is the top rack. The silverware rack (or at least I think that's what it is for). It removes the necessity of the basket that usually sits on the bottom rack and separates it entirely. Of course, the basket is still included, but I honestly don't have it in my dishwasher at current time. Two is that it quite frankly has a lot of capacity. I'm able to fit a surprising amount of dishes into this dang thing and have it run effectively. Part of this is because of the aforementioned silverware rack. Means I can remove the basket and just have that much more space for random dishes and/or cookware. Three is that this dishwasher is surprisingly quiet. I was expecting it to be noisy just like every other dishwasher I've used, but it isn't. You can obviously still hear it, but it's not loud at all. Both of the folks that I live with remarked this when I ran it for the first time. Fourth is its ability great ability to wash stuff. Everything has come out very clean since I've bought this. No residue, nothing. The only downside here is that it doesn't have an inbuilt food grinder, so you definitely have to scrape off dishes before using it, but who doesn't do that? Barbarians (and probably small children), that's who. Moving away from that, this dishwasher has SmartThings functionality, but I'm honestly at a loss for how this particular functionality can actually be useful in any sense. I'm not entirely certain why anyone would need to control their dishwasher remotely. I guess for the laziest of the laziest or those with mansions? Idk, seems like a waste of design time for R&D. Overall, this is a great dishwasher that functions exquisitely and has the capacity to make life easy. I highly recommend it and wish that my last dishwasher was a Samsung. Quite frankly, I didn't think a dishwasher could function quite this well.

Sentence (English): This is my second Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my second Bosch dishwasher. We replaced a highly rated, but misinstalled kitchenaid washer. Compared to the kitchenaid, this washer is not as sturdy. It has much more plastic inside and out. Hopefully it lasts. The Bosch feels much more rickety and even the stainless front isn't as durable feeling. You have to be careful with the 3 drawers- I'm worried my teenager will break them. It is definitely louder than the kitchenaid, I even added more sound insulation when installing. When installing, this Bosch does not have rollers, like other heavy dishwashers, which is too bad. Leveling seems primitive. There is a way to raise the back from the front, so you don't have to drag it out repeatedly. The front legs are pathetic plastic levelers. Luckily, you should only have to use them once. I'm used to seeing the time remaining in a cycle. This one has a red light that shines on the floor. It wouldn't have been hard to make that a timer, like the old ceiling projection alarm clocks. It seems to wash well, judging from the first 5 washes. Time will tell. My overall impression is that for the price, it is not made as well as other brands. If it can last 20 years I'll be happy. If it doesn't last 10, I would not buy Bosch again.

Sentence (English): I bought a dishwasher off Miele directly, a little over two years ago.
Comments (English): I bought a dishwasher off Miele directly, a little over two years ago. I made contact via a phonecall with their service department a year after ownership because the bottom of the front panel was rusting. I was told it would be dealt with and I would hear back shortly. I didn't hear anything after a few months so sent an email - the response was I was outside the service area but something would be arranged. I heard nothing so after a month I followed up again, and was told the Service Manager hadn't responded but it had been marked urgent and a fix would be found. And then silence. So over a year later I phoned the CS line again and was told it would be resolved, then in a subsequent phonecall, that a service tehnician would visit within a week. they didn't turn up and when I phoned I was told it was because I was outside the service area. which I had pointed out in the initial phonecall. Finally after another phonecall, a local whiteware repairer was engaged, a service person visited my property inspected the dishwasher, and submitted a report to Miele - I then received a phonecall to say this had been brought back under the Miele service team as one of their technicians was going to be in my area on Thursday of that week - I stayed home from work and waited. And no one turned up. Nor did I get a phonecall to advise me ANYTHING. I am beyond frustrated. I have attemped to resolve this by persevering with Miele directly, but haven't gotten anywhere. It has cost me time and money. All on top of a dishwasher which performs poorly - it doesn't dry properly, doesn't have a quick cycle function (the shortest is over 2 hours), it cleans ok, but the rust that was only along the bottom panel is now showing in places along the top of the panel. And so here I am: buyer beware!

Sentence (English): A dishwasher is a must-have for those who find washing dishes a chore.
Comments (English): [ Get your dishwasher on and off quickly and easily ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher is a must-have for those who find washing dishes a chore. I finally got one! :) This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. [Review Summary] ㆍ It's larger than I expected and quite heavy. While it might seem like a small appliance, it's not exactly small. Considering it's supposed to hold three servings of dishes, the interior is quite spacious! ㆍ Excellent cleaning power ㆍ Easy and intuitive installation. Dishwashers are often considered essential appliances these days, but my house is old and didn't have one! It's sad to say, "I've finally completed my appliance collection!" Unfortunately, my cabinets aren't quite right, so there wasn't enough room for a Minix dishwasher. To be exact, the height wasn't right. I measured the actual product before ordering, but I don't know if I misjudged it or if I didn't consider the actual space. My first impression was that the packaging was quite well done. I was wondering how to get it out of the box, but one side was open, so I just cut the string and it was easy to get it out! I liked how the packaging was well-made, without any scratches. I even unpacked it and wanted to use it, so I installed it a couple of times and used it on the floor. But I realized this really wouldn't work, so I'm currently making some space. This thing is taller and bigger than I thought. However, being tall and tall >>> means there's a decent amount of usable laundry space. At first, I wondered if this would fit three people, but it actually has quite a bit of storage space if you stack them up. I tested the cleaning power, and it's excellent! Aside from the rice that dried and wouldn't fall off, it seems to wash most things well. Don't you feel lazy about washing dishes right after eating? Just put them in and press "beep." Installation was really easy! My family, who is not very good at machines, was able to install and use it simply by reading the manual, which says it all. There's also a video explanation with a QR code in the manual, so if you follow it, you should be able to do it. However, the machine itself is a bit heavy. I heard from someone else that a woman could lift it by herself, so I tried it, but it seems to be quite heavy. There was a lot of talk about this and that, but in the end, I'm satisfied with the overall experience. The fact that the machine won't turn on is just a problem in my house. I'm going to try to solve it somehow. I recommend this to anyone who doesn't want to bother doing the dishes right after eating~! ~~!

While it might seem like a small appliance, it's not exactly small. Considering it's supposed to hold three servings of dishes, the interior is quite spacious! ㆍ Excellent cleaning power ㆍ Easy and intuitive installation. Dishwashers are often considered essential appliances these days, but my house is old and didn't have one! It's sad to say, "I've finally completed my appliance collection!" Unfortunately, my cabinets aren't quite right, so there wasn't enough room for a Minix dishwasher. To be exact, the height wasn't right. I heard from someone else that a woman could lift it by herself, so I tried it, but it seems to be quite heavy. There was a lot of talk about this and that, but in the end, I'm satisfied with the overall experience. The fact that the machine won't turn on is just a problem in my house. I'm going to try to solve it somehow. I recommend this to anyone who doesn't want to bother doing the dishes right after eating~! ~~!

While it might seem like a small appliance, it's not exactly small. Considering it's supposed to hold three servings of dishes, the interior is quite spacious! ㆍ Excellent cleaning power ㆍ Easy and intuitive installation. Dishwashers are often considered essential appliances these days, but my house is old and didn't have one! It's sad to say, "I've finally completed my appliance collection!" Unfortunately, my cabinets aren't quite right, so there wasn't enough room for a Minix dishwasher. To be exact, the height wasn't right. I measured the actual product before ordering, but I don't know if I misjudged it or if I didn't consider the actual space. My first impression was that the packaging was quite well done. There's also a video explanation with a QR code in the manual, so if you follow it, you should be able to do it. However, the machine itself is a bit heavy. I heard from someone else that a woman could lift it by herself, so I tried it, but it seems to be quite heavy. There was a lot of talk about this and that, but in the end, I'm satisfied with the overall experience. The fact that the machine won't turn on is just a problem in my house. I'm going to try to solve it somehow. I recommend this to anyone who doesn't want to bother doing the dishes right after eating~! ~~!

While it might seem like a small appliance, it's not exactly small. Considering it's supposed to hold three servings of dishes, the interior is quite spacious! ㆍ Excellent cleaning power ㆍ Easy and intuitive installation. Dishwashers are often considered essential appliances these days, but my house is old and didn't have one! It's sad to say, "I've finally completed my appliance collection!" Unfortunately, my cabinets aren't quite right, so there wasn't enough room for a Minix dishwasher. To be exact, the height wasn't right. I measured the actual product before ordering, but I don't know if I misjudged it or if I didn't consider the actual space. My first impression was that the packaging was quite well done. I heard from someone else that a woman could lift it by herself, so I tried it, but it seems to be quite heavy. There was a lot of talk about this and that, but in the end, I'm satisfied with the overall experience. The fact that the machine won't turn on is just a problem in my house. I'm going to try to solve it somehow. I recommend this to anyone who doesn't want to bother doing the dishes right after eating~! ~~!

Considering it's supposed to hold three servings of dishes, the interior is quite spacious! ㆍ Excellent cleaning power ㆍ Easy and intuitive installation. Dishwashers are often considered essential appliances these days, but my house is old and didn't have one! It's sad to say, "I've finally completed my appliance collection!" I heard from someone else that a woman could lift it by herself, so I tried it, but it seems to be quite heavy. There was a lot of talk about this and that, but in the end, I'm satisfied with the overall experience. The fact that the machine won't turn on is just a problem in my house. I'm going to try to solve it somehow. I recommend this to anyone who doesn't want to bother doing the dishes right after eating~! ~~!

I finally got one! :) This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. [Review Summary] ㆍ It's larger than I expected and quite heavy. While it might seem like a small appliance, it's not exactly small. Considering it's supposed to hold three servings of dishes, the interior is quite spacious! ㆍ Excellent cleaning power ㆍ Easy and intuitive installation. Dishwashers are often considered essential appliances these days, but my house is old and didn't have one! It's sad to say, "I've finally completed my appliance collection!" Unfortunately, my cabinets aren't quite right, so there wasn't enough room for a Minix dishwasher. To be exact, the height wasn't right. I measured the actual product before ordering, but I don't know if I misjudged it or if I didn't consider the actual space. My first impression was that the packaging was quite well done. I was wondering how to get it out of the box, but one side was open, so I just cut the string and it was easy to get it out! I liked how the packaging was well-made, without any scratches. I even unpacked it and wanted to use it, so I installed it a couple of times and used it on the floor. But I realized this really wouldn't work, so I'm currently making some space. This thing is taller and bigger than I thought. However, being tall and tall >>> means there's a decent amount of usable laundry space. At first, I wondered if this would fit three people, but it actually has quite a bit of storage space if you stack them up. I tested the cleaning power, and it's excellent! Aside from the rice that dried and wouldn't fall off, it seems to wash most things well. Don't you feel lazy about washing dishes right after eating? Just put them in and press "beep." Installation was really easy! My family, who is not very good at machines, was able to install and use it simply by reading the manual, which says it all. There's also a video explanation with a QR code in the manual, so if you follow it, you should be able to do it. However, the machine itself is a bit heavy. I heard from someone else that a woman could lift it by herself, so I tried it, but it seems to be quite heavy. There was a lot of talk about this and that, but in the end, I'm satisfied with the overall experience. The fact that the machine won't turn on is just a problem in my house. I'm going to try to solve it somehow. I recommend this to anyone who doesn't want to bother doing the dishes right after eating~! ~~!

Sentence (English): I used to use a dishwasher, but when I moved, I started doing the dishes myself.
Comments (English): I used to use a dishwasher, but when I moved, I started doing the dishes myself. The first few times were fine, but after work, I was exhausted from having to juggle childcare and housework, and with less time to spend with my kids, I found myself neglecting them. After months of researching different products, comparing prices, and even asking Chat GPT for comparisons, I finally decided to purchase one just in time for Chuseok. Since my kids are older and don't need 100-degree sterilization, I chose a product that sticks to the basics. I searched several websites, but the official website had the best installation schedule and price. They installed it quickly, according to my schedule, and I appreciated the detailed instructions provided during the installation process. I used it with just my regular tablet detergent for the first day, then followed the recommendation of adding rinse aid and salt for water softening. It washed really well, without any fishy smell or stains. My previous dishwasher didn't use a separate rinse aid, but I definitely felt the benefit of using the dedicated rinse aid. I highly recommend this one for a pleasant dishwashing experience. Sentence (English): Cleans well.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well, quiet, could use better controls ] || ---------------- || Cleans well. Quiet. Drying can be a little iffy if you don't use rinse aid, even if you're using Crystal Dry. I don't like how long it takes from the time you press the On button until it turns on. Many times, I've touched it again because I thought it didn't take and then the machine basically turned on and then right back off again. In general, I don't like the feel of the buttons. You can't tell if you pressed it or not. You also have to hold the door open to use the buttons, because it has a strong enough spring that it wants to close. I don't like that you can't tell how long is left in the cycle. I like the adjustable silverware rack so you can put in slightly larger utensils like a grill spatula, etc. I haven't experimented with the zone control yet. To be honest, I want all the controls on the machine itself. I'm just not interested in using an app to control my dishwasher.
