Comments (English): [ Want SQUEAKY Clean dishes? Bosch is where it's at! ] || ---------------- || This Bosch 500 Series is legitimately the absolute best when it comes to just how clean your dishes will come out. I have used GE, Samsung, Kenmore and Whirlpool and using the exact same detergent, the Bosch makes everything absolutely "squeaky clean" it's as if absolutely 0 grease/grime/sticky residue is left, trust me, it's a different you can definitely feel with all other dishwashers. They sure all clean well but Bosch has some sort of magic that makes everything THAT much cleaner, absolutely love it! Another big win is the configuration of the bottom drawer. The inner section is the common setup of all tines going "horizontally" (from side to side) and it fits lost of dishes BUT the outer section flips this 180 and then there's 2 rows that stack "vertically" (from front to rear) and this is what allows the medium and smaller plates to fit in so much better than if both had been the same. You'll notice this in your regular dishwasher as there's usually a bit of wasted space when stacking large with medium/small plates. Definitely a very "German" approach to space utilization. The one thing I don't like is that only 1 cutlery tray is included, the manual kinda pushes you to use the 3rd rack for this BUT this is way much more time consuming as you need to lay your cutlery in neatly within each slot vs just dropping them in at the bottom. I ended up ordering another since I found myself filling up that little tray way before the dishwasher was full. The upper rack is pretty generic but not in a bad way, it works for all your mugs, cups, small bowls, etc. The thing I like the MOST (and maybe this is where the magic of the squeaky clean dishes comes from) is the handle is used as a spot for the dishwashing tablet to drop to when the lid opens for the main wash, this allows the tablet to stay here vs dropping to the bottom of the dishwasher and completely dissolve (my whirlpool ALWAYS had a small residue in there so I definitely appreciate this). The 3rd rack is a very handy addition to catch those little items that are always so hard to find a place for because they either slide through the tines and fall to the bottom, or take up the room of where a plate/cup would go. I use this mostly for my many pyrex lids, tongs, spatulas, lids etc etc, it allows for one very organized, very large and very clean load each time! Then there's the Bosch / Home Connect app, it is definitely the most robust and feature loaded one of all the ones I've tried! It has a full suite of settings (even custom ones that aren't readily available such as "rinse") as well as custom ones that can be saved as a "favorite". In all honesty I use the "auto" mode 90% of the time since the dishwasher uses turbidity sensors to "see" how dirty the load is and how much or little it needs to run to keep it clean BUT having the rinse only option as well as the "extra quiet" option on the app is used more often than I realized I would. Comparing it to the Samsung app (which was my favorite before I had the Bosch), this one has tons of videos that show you how to properly load the dishwasher, how to use its features, explanation on the cleaning modes, energy consumption, time to completion, etc etc. It feels like overlaod at first until you get more familiar with it and then you'll find yourself using it more than you realize. Or you can just simply select "auto" on the dishwasher and forget it and let it do all the figuring for you and have very, very squeaky clean dishes. If there were half stars, I would have given this a 4.5 instead of 4 just because of the lack of a 2nd cutlery tray, no frontal display that allows you to see how much time is left on the load (you either open the door temporarily and there's a 2 hr + , 1-2 hours, less than 1 hour remaining) indicator or check on the app) when my samsung shows a time to completion that I check often, and that it's not the absolute quitest that I've tried. All in all though, if anyone asks me if I'd recommend this, I'd have a very resounding yes! You won't regret it especially with the solid reliabilty that Bosch dishwashers are known for!

Sentence (English): LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 12-Person (Nature Beige) Review 1.
Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher, whose quality of life is changing ] || ---------------- || LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher 12-Person (Nature Beige) Review 1. Design and Installation * Objet Design: The Nature Beige color evokes a warm, luxurious feel that complements any kitchen interior, and the built-in installation creates a clean, unified look. * Installation Satisfaction: The staff arrived on time and on the exact date I requested. They were very friendly and provided detailed instructions on how to operate the dishwasher. 2. Key Features and Cleaning Power * Powerful Cleaning Power: The 80-degree tornado water jet washes even greasy and stained dishes thoroughly. It's truly amazing. This is the first time in my 60-year life that I've experienced this. It's incredibly convenient. I'm extremely satisfied with the cleaning performance. 3. Drying and Convenience * Automatic Door Opening Drying: The door automatically opens after washing to vent any moisture inside, allowing you to conveniently dry the dishwasher without having to worry about anything else. This feature greatly enhances user convenience. It's a whole new world, because even if I just fall asleep, the dishes are fluffy and clean the next morning. * Some users have left reviews complaining about the lack of a drying function, but I'm satisfied with the automatic door opening, which effectively releases moisture. * Low noise: Many reviews say the noise level is low, so it can be used at night without worry. Based on my experience, I think even people who are sensitive to noise will be satisfied with it. * Economical: It feels like water and electricity usage is reduced compared to washing dishes by hand, so I'm satisfied with the economical aspect as well. 4. Disappointing Points * Dishwashing Arrangement: The dishwasher may seem a bit difficult to arrange at first, but you'll quickly get used to it after a few uses. I felt the same way. * Detergent Selection: Cleaning power can vary depending on the detergent you use, so it's important to choose a dishwasher-specific detergent. Overall Review: The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a "life-enhancing appliance" with excellent cleaning power, a luxurious design, and convenient features like an automatic door opening dryer/water softener. This is a highly satisfying product that reduces dishwashing time and allows you to spend that time on more productive activities.

Sentence (English): When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I finally decided to buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher. Since I wanted to buy something pretty, I didn't even consider anything other than the LG Objet Collection. There were several models, but the price skyrocketed with features like steam and other features. Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day. So, I pulled myself together and decided to focus on design and basic dishwashing. That's why I chose this DUE1BGLE model. I used a credit card discount on Coupang to order it, and the installation, as expected from Rocket Installation, was incredibly fast. However, since we moved to a new house, our kitchen got bigger, so we had to install it in a corner, requiring reinforcement work before installation. That added an additional cost of about 80,000 won. This was inevitable given our unique circumstances. Still, the installer contacted me an hour in advance to explain the situation, outline the work, and get approval beforehand to proceed with the installation. He was incredibly friendly. The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier. First of all, thanks to the "Tornado Washing Blade," it cleans every nook and cranny better than I expected. Especially with things like dried rice stuck to children's plates and bowls, doing it by hand can be a bit stressful, but it's so refreshing to see them clean. And the "80-degree high-temperature sterilization" thing—I was worried because it didn't use steam, but when I touched the dishes after washing, they were hot, which was a relief, knowing they were sterilized properly. I don't think I'll need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer anymore. Of course, there are some drawbacks. Since there's no steam, sometimes things stuck to the pot I used to make curry or stew stay there if I don't pre-wash them. Well, that's nothing compared to the dishwashing hell, so I just rinse them once and put them back in. I guess I have to make some compromises. And about the drying issue everyone talks about! There's a tip for that. After washing, when you hear the "ding-dong" sound, don't open the door right away. Just let it sit for an hour or two. The remaining heat inside dries most glassware and ceramics fluffy without a trace of moisture. Of course, water can't be helped if it collects in the plastic container or lid groove, but that can be easily shaken off. I'm very satisfied with this. In conclusion, it is a product that is 'valued for its design', but the basics are solid enough that I don't feel like I wasted my money. It is not a perfect appliance that solves everything perfectly, but I think it is worth the price just for giving me time to relax on the sofa with my wife after dinner. For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! ' but who also want to find a reasonable compromise, I think this is a really good choice. I recommend it!

Sentence (English): Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day.
Comments (English): [ I finally decided to buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher. Since I wanted to buy something pretty, I didn't even consider anything other than the LG Objet Collection. There were several models, but the price skyrocketed with features like steam and other features. Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day. So, I pulled myself together and decided to focus on design and basic dishwashing. That's why I chose this DUE1BGLE model. I used a credit card discount on Coupang to order it, and the installation, as expected from Rocket Installation, was incredibly fast. However, since we moved to a new house, our kitchen got bigger, so we had to install it in a corner, requiring reinforcement work before installation. That added an additional cost of about 80,000 won. This was inevitable given our unique circumstances. Still, the installer contacted me an hour in advance to explain the situation, outline the work, and get approval beforehand to proceed with the installation. He was incredibly friendly. The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier. First of all, thanks to the "Tornado Washing Blade," it cleans every nook and cranny better than I expected. Especially with things like dried rice stuck to children's plates and bowls, doing it by hand can be a bit stressful, but it's so refreshing to see them clean. And the "80-degree high-temperature sterilization" thing—I was worried because it didn't use steam, but when I touched the dishes after washing, they were hot, which was a relief, knowing they were sterilized properly. I don't think I'll need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer anymore. Of course, there are some drawbacks. Since there's no steam, sometimes things stuck to the pot I used to make curry or stew stay there if I don't pre-wash them. Well, that's nothing compared to the dishwashing hell, so I just rinse them once and put them back in. I guess I have to make some compromises. And about the drying issue everyone talks about! There's a tip for that. After washing, when you hear the "ding-dong" sound, don't open the door right away. Just let it sit for an hour or two. The remaining heat inside dries most glassware and ceramics fluffy without a trace of moisture. Of course, water can't be helped if it collects in the plastic container or lid groove, but that can be easily shaken off. I'm very satisfied with this. In conclusion, it is a product that is 'valued for its design', but the basics are solid enough that I don't feel like I wasted my money. It is not a perfect appliance that solves everything perfectly, but I think it is worth the price just for giving me time to relax on the sofa with my wife after dinner. For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! ' but who also want to find a reasonable compromise, I think this is a really good choice. I recommend it!

Comments (English): [ I finally decided to buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher. Since I wanted to buy something pretty, I didn't even consider anything other than the LG Objet Collection. There were several models, but the price skyrocketed with features like steam and other features. Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day. So, I pulled myself together and decided to focus on design and basic dishwashing. That's why I chose this DUE1BGLE model. I used a credit card discount on Coupang to order it, and the installation, as expected from Rocket Installation, was incredibly fast. However, since we moved to a new house, our kitchen got bigger, so we had to install it in a corner, requiring reinforcement work before installation. That added an additional cost of about 80,000 won. This was inevitable given our unique circumstances. Still, the installer contacted me an hour in advance to explain the situation, outline the work, and get approval beforehand to proceed with the installation. He was incredibly friendly. The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier. First of all, thanks to the "Tornado Washing Blade," it cleans every nook and cranny better than I expected. Especially with things like dried rice stuck to children's plates and bowls, doing it by hand can be a bit stressful, but it's so refreshing to see them clean. And the "80-degree high-temperature sterilization" thing—I was worried because it didn't use steam, but when I touched the dishes after washing, they were hot, which was a relief, knowing they were sterilized properly. I don't think I'll need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer anymore. Of course, there are some drawbacks. Since there's no steam, sometimes things stuck to the pot I used to make curry or stew stay there if I don't pre-wash them. Well, that's nothing compared to the dishwashing hell, so I just rinse them once and put them back in. I guess I have to make some compromises. And about the drying issue everyone talks about! There's a tip for that. After washing, when you hear the "ding-dong" sound, don't open the door right away. Just let it sit for an hour or two. The remaining heat inside dries most glassware and ceramics fluffy without a trace of moisture. Of course, water can't be helped if it collects in the plastic container or lid groove, but that can be easily shaken off. I'm very satisfied with this. In conclusion, it is a product that is 'valued for its design', but the basics are solid enough that I don't feel like I wasted my money. It is not a perfect appliance that solves everything perfectly, but I think it is worth the price just for giving me time to relax on the sofa with my wife after dinner. For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! ' but who also want to find a reasonable compromise, I think this is a really good choice. I recommend it!

Sentence (English): The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier.
Comments (English): [ I finally decided to buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher. Since I wanted to buy something pretty, I didn't even consider anything other than the LG Objet Collection. There were several models, but the price skyrocketed with features like steam and other features. Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day. So, I pulled myself together and decided to focus on design and basic dishwashing. That's why I chose this DUE1BGLE model. I used a credit card discount on Coupang to order it, and the installation, as expected from Rocket Installation, was incredibly fast. However, since we moved to a new house, our kitchen got bigger, so we had to install it in a corner, requiring reinforcement work before installation. That added an additional cost of about 80,000 won. This was inevitable given our unique circumstances. Still, the installer contacted me an hour in advance to explain the situation, outline the work, and get approval beforehand to proceed with the installation. He was incredibly friendly. The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier. First of all, thanks to the "Tornado Washing Blade," it cleans every nook and cranny better than I expected. Especially with things like dried rice stuck to children's plates and bowls, doing it by hand can be a bit stressful, but it's so refreshing to see them clean. And the "80-degree high-temperature sterilization" thing—I was worried because it didn't use steam, but when I touched the dishes after washing, they were hot, which was a relief, knowing they were sterilized properly. I don't think I'll need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer anymore. Of course, there are some drawbacks. Since there's no steam, sometimes things stuck to the pot I used to make curry or stew stay there if I don't pre-wash them. Well, that's nothing compared to the dishwashing hell, so I just rinse them once and put them back in. I guess I have to make some compromises. And about the drying issue everyone talks about! There's a tip for that. After washing, when you hear the "ding-dong" sound, don't open the door right away. Just let it sit for an hour or two. The remaining heat inside dries most glassware and ceramics fluffy without a trace of moisture. Of course, water can't be helped if it collects in the plastic container or lid groove, but that can be easily shaken off. I'm very satisfied with this. In conclusion, it is a product that is 'valued for its design', but the basics are solid enough that I don't feel like I wasted my money. It is not a perfect appliance that solves everything perfectly, but I think it is worth the price just for giving me time to relax on the sofa with my wife after dinner. For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! ' but who also want to find a reasonable compromise, I think this is a really good choice. I recommend it!

Comments (English): [ I finally decided to buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher. Since I wanted to buy something pretty, I didn't even consider anything other than the LG Objet Collection. There were several models, but the price skyrocketed with features like steam and other features. Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day. So, I pulled myself together and decided to focus on design and basic dishwashing. That's why I chose this DUE1BGLE model. I used a credit card discount on Coupang to order it, and the installation, as expected from Rocket Installation, was incredibly fast. However, since we moved to a new house, our kitchen got bigger, so we had to install it in a corner, requiring reinforcement work before installation. That added an additional cost of about 80,000 won. This was inevitable given our unique circumstances. Still, the installer contacted me an hour in advance to explain the situation, outline the work, and get approval beforehand to proceed with the installation. He was incredibly friendly. The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier. First of all, thanks to the "Tornado Washing Blade," it cleans every nook and cranny better than I expected. Especially with things like dried rice stuck to children's plates and bowls, doing it by hand can be a bit stressful, but it's so refreshing to see them clean. And the "80-degree high-temperature sterilization" thing—I was worried because it didn't use steam, but when I touched the dishes after washing, they were hot, which was a relief, knowing they were sterilized properly. I don't think I'll need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer anymore. Of course, there are some drawbacks. Since there's no steam, sometimes things stuck to the pot I used to make curry or stew stay there if I don't pre-wash them. Well, that's nothing compared to the dishwashing hell, so I just rinse them once and put them back in. I guess I have to make some compromises. And about the drying issue everyone talks about! There's a tip for that. After washing, when you hear the "ding-dong" sound, don't open the door right away. Just let it sit for an hour or two. The remaining heat inside dries most glassware and ceramics fluffy without a trace of moisture. Of course, water can't be helped if it collects in the plastic container or lid groove, but that can be easily shaken off. I'm very satisfied with this. In conclusion, it is a product that is 'valued for its design', but the basics are solid enough that I don't feel like I wasted my money. It is not a perfect appliance that solves everything perfectly, but I think it is worth the price just for giving me time to relax on the sofa with my wife after dinner. For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! ' but who also want to find a reasonable compromise, I think this is a really good choice. I recommend it!

Comments (English): [ I finally decided to buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher. Since I wanted to buy something pretty, I didn't even consider anything other than the LG Objet Collection. There were several models, but the price skyrocketed with features like steam and other features. Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day. So, I pulled myself together and decided to focus on design and basic dishwashing. That's why I chose this DUE1BGLE model. I used a credit card discount on Coupang to order it, and the installation, as expected from Rocket Installation, was incredibly fast. However, since we moved to a new house, our kitchen got bigger, so we had to install it in a corner, requiring reinforcement work before installation. That added an additional cost of about 80,000 won. This was inevitable given our unique circumstances. Still, the installer contacted me an hour in advance to explain the situation, outline the work, and get approval beforehand to proceed with the installation. He was incredibly friendly. The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier. First of all, thanks to the "Tornado Washing Blade," it cleans every nook and cranny better than I expected. Especially with things like dried rice stuck to children's plates and bowls, doing it by hand can be a bit stressful, but it's so refreshing to see them clean. And the "80-degree high-temperature sterilization" thing—I was worried because it didn't use steam, but when I touched the dishes after washing, they were hot, which was a relief, knowing they were sterilized properly. I don't think I'll need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer anymore. Of course, there are some drawbacks. Since there's no steam, sometimes things stuck to the pot I used to make curry or stew stay there if I don't pre-wash them. Well, that's nothing compared to the dishwashing hell, so I just rinse them once and put them back in. I guess I have to make some compromises. And about the drying issue everyone talks about! There's a tip for that. After washing, when you hear the "ding-dong" sound, don't open the door right away. Just let it sit for an hour or two. The remaining heat inside dries most glassware and ceramics fluffy without a trace of moisture. Of course, water can't be helped if it collects in the plastic container or lid groove, but that can be easily shaken off. I'm very satisfied with this. In conclusion, it is a product that is 'valued for its design', but the basics are solid enough that I don't feel like I wasted my money. It is not a perfect appliance that solves everything perfectly, but I think it is worth the price just for giving me time to relax on the sofa with my wife after dinner. For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! ' but who also want to find a reasonable compromise, I think this is a really good choice. I recommend it!

Comments (English): [ I finally decided to buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher. Since I wanted to buy something pretty, I didn't even consider anything other than the LG Objet Collection. There were several models, but the price skyrocketed with features like steam and other features. Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day. So, I pulled myself together and decided to focus on design and basic dishwashing. That's why I chose this DUE1BGLE model. I used a credit card discount on Coupang to order it, and the installation, as expected from Rocket Installation, was incredibly fast. However, since we moved to a new house, our kitchen got bigger, so we had to install it in a corner, requiring reinforcement work before installation. That added an additional cost of about 80,000 won. This was inevitable given our unique circumstances. Still, the installer contacted me an hour in advance to explain the situation, outline the work, and get approval beforehand to proceed with the installation. He was incredibly friendly. The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier. First of all, thanks to the "Tornado Washing Blade," it cleans every nook and cranny better than I expected. Especially with things like dried rice stuck to children's plates and bowls, doing it by hand can be a bit stressful, but it's so refreshing to see them clean. And the "80-degree high-temperature sterilization" thing—I was worried because it didn't use steam, but when I touched the dishes after washing, they were hot, which was a relief, knowing they were sterilized properly. I don't think I'll need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer anymore. Of course, there are some drawbacks. Since there's no steam, sometimes things stuck to the pot I used to make curry or stew stay there if I don't pre-wash them. Well, that's nothing compared to the dishwashing hell, so I just rinse them once and put them back in. I guess I have to make some compromises. And about the drying issue everyone talks about! There's a tip for that. After washing, when you hear the "ding-dong" sound, don't open the door right away. Just let it sit for an hour or two. The remaining heat inside dries most glassware and ceramics fluffy without a trace of moisture. Of course, water can't be helped if it collects in the plastic container or lid groove, but that can be easily shaken off. I'm very satisfied with this. In conclusion, it is a product that is 'valued for its design', but the basics are solid enough that I don't feel like I wasted my money. It is not a perfect appliance that solves everything perfectly, but I think it is worth the price just for giving me time to relax on the sofa with my wife after dinner. For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! ' but who also want to find a reasonable compromise, I think this is a really good choice. I recommend it!

Sentence (English): For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! '
Comments (English): [ I finally decided to buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When we moved, I promised my wife I'd buy her a dishwasher. Since I wanted to buy something pretty, I didn't even consider anything other than the LG Objet Collection. There were several models, but the price skyrocketed with features like steam and other features. Honestly, we're not a household that burns pots every day. So, I pulled myself together and decided to focus on design and basic dishwashing. That's why I chose this DUE1BGLE model. I used a credit card discount on Coupang to order it, and the installation, as expected from Rocket Installation, was incredibly fast. However, since we moved to a new house, our kitchen got bigger, so we had to install it in a corner, requiring reinforcement work before installation. That added an additional cost of about 80,000 won. This was inevitable given our unique circumstances. Still, the installer contacted me an hour in advance to explain the situation, outline the work, and get approval beforehand to proceed with the installation. He was incredibly friendly. The first impression I got after installing and running it was... Wow, I really wondered why I bought it earlier. First of all, thanks to the "Tornado Washing Blade," it cleans every nook and cranny better than I expected. Especially with things like dried rice stuck to children's plates and bowls, doing it by hand can be a bit stressful, but it's so refreshing to see them clean. And the "80-degree high-temperature sterilization" thing—I was worried because it didn't use steam, but when I touched the dishes after washing, they were hot, which was a relief, knowing they were sterilized properly. I don't think I'll need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer anymore. Of course, there are some drawbacks. Since there's no steam, sometimes things stuck to the pot I used to make curry or stew stay there if I don't pre-wash them. Well, that's nothing compared to the dishwashing hell, so I just rinse them once and put them back in. I guess I have to make some compromises. And about the drying issue everyone talks about! There's a tip for that. After washing, when you hear the "ding-dong" sound, don't open the door right away. Just let it sit for an hour or two. The remaining heat inside dries most glassware and ceramics fluffy without a trace of moisture. Of course, water can't be helped if it collects in the plastic container or lid groove, but that can be easily shaken off. I'm very satisfied with this. In conclusion, it is a product that is 'valued for its design', but the basics are solid enough that I don't feel like I wasted my money. It is not a perfect appliance that solves everything perfectly, but I think it is worth the price just for giving me time to relax on the sofa with my wife after dinner. For those of you who, like me, say 'I can never give up on kitchen interior! ' but who also want to find a reasonable compromise, I think this is a really good choice. I recommend it!

Seeing the descriptions claiming the same design and components, I began to wonder, "Can I trust it?" So, I watched YouTube review videos, comparing model numbers and specifications. Moreover, considering the price I paid now compared to the store price I compared last time, I'm proud to say that it was a smart economical choice. Of course, you can't judge everything after just one or two uses, but so far, I have no regrets and wonder why I didn't change it sooner. If anyone around me is having the same concerns, I can confidently tell them that after carefully comparing the model name, features, and component configuration, it can be a reliable choice even online.

Comments (English): LG Electronics Dios Objet Collection Built-in 14-Person Dishwasher, 3-Stackable, with 14-Person Salt, Detergent, and Rinse Dispenser Left Over! I recently installed a 14-person dishwasher during my recent kitchen remodel. Honestly, it was my first time using a proper dishwasher, so I was skeptical, but I'm glad I did. I used a mini version of the non-perforated dishwasher before, and I didn't realize it then, but using an expensive one makes a difference. Almost all of my appliances are LG, so I chose LG again this time. The mop base is 15cm, so the only available model is the 10cm model. I deliberately chose the stainless steel color, and the design is incredibly sophisticated. It matches the kitchen door color perfectly, and because it's built-in, it makes for a clean, space-saving experience. It's also virtually silent. It's quiet enough to be used right next to a conversation without disturbing anyone. I'm also very satisfied with its performance. It's hygienically safe thanks to its hot air drying and steam sterilization. I've tried a variety of dishes, including glass cups, baby dishes, and stainless steel pots, and they all come out sparkling clean without any water marks. In the past, even after washing with a scrubbing sponge, the subtle grease and odors that would linger were completely removed, leaving a refreshing feeling. The steam function is especially great. Even greasy plates and frying pans were cleaned thoroughly without needing to rinse beforehand. It's large enough for 14 people, so I only need to run it once a day to clean all the dishes. The internal basket is well-designed, so even large pots and cutting boards can fit in it if you adjust the angle just right. The shelf height is easily adjustable, allowing for flexible settings for different cups and glasses. The drying power is also excellent. The hot air drying keeps everything fluffy and dry, and leaving the door slightly open after washing quickly removes any remaining moisture. Just organizing the dishes after washing used to be a chore, but now, thanks to this dishwasher, my kitchen work has been cut in half. I was even more satisfied with the 10% rebate. Overall, the design, performance, and hygiene are all perfect. I highly recommend this dishwasher to anyone looking for a quiet and clean dishwasher.

Ultimately the dishwasher is great, really quiet and cleans very well. Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ It's just one dishwasher, but it really changes the quality of life~^^ ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. This is an honest review written after using the product provided for free as part of a Coupang experience group event. I am a meticulous person, so it takes a long time to wash dishes. As I get older, my hands get wet from time to time, and I also get back pain from frequent housework. So, I was thinking about installing a dishwasher when I moved, but since we are a family of two, I was worried that I would only do things myself. Then, rather than installing a large-capacity dishwasher, I looked into a portable, small-capacity dishwasher. Then, I found the Mydia 6-person automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher and got a great opportunity to try it out. The delivery was made the next day by a delivery person who visited me in person and installed it by drilling a small 10mm hole in the kitchen countertop so that it didn't look bad from an aesthetic standpoint. He kindly explained how to use it and tested it, so it wasn't too difficult. I will write down the pros and cons that I felt after using it for two weeks from that evening. The 6-person dishwasher has a slim two-tier structure with a white color and a round design, so it looks simple and luxurious no matter where it is placed in the kitchen. Sterilization/drying. Low temperature. Powerful. Normal. Depending on the washing temperature and the number of rinses, you can choose from four courses according to the level of contamination of the dishes, allowing for more thorough washing. The LED display and control method allow for easy and simple operation, and the two-tier basket makes it easy to store and wash everything from small dishes to greasy dishes such as pots and frying pans. The upper, middle, and lower three-tier washing wings spray powerful washing water to clean between dishes without stains, and the soaking function is excellent for removing stuck-on food (there is a strainer at the bottom to filter out any remaining residue, so please wash it once in a while). The window-type door type allows you to see the washing process with your eyes, so it is not stuffy, and you can see if the washing wings are working properly without getting caught on the dishes, and if the dishes are being washed well, so you can feel secure. You can add additional dishes after operation, so you can wash without losing any dishes. If you set the hot air drying function in advance, the high-temperature hot air will remove the air filled inside the dishwasher during the final stage of washing, and after completion, the automatic door opening function will slightly open the door to discharge the moisture inside the dishwasher. It slowly dries the dishes, removing musty smells and moisture. Among the many advantages, I am most satisfied with the automatic door opening function along with the window door. Disadvantages & regrets *Energy efficiency is level 4 *For 6 people -> It is difficult to wash dishes for 6 people. It is suitable for washing dishes for 2 to 4 people *The sterilization/drying function is not a drying function alone, but a rinse/drying function *Even after washing is complete with hot air drying, some moisture remains on the dishes, and in particular, some water is collected on the top of the cups **Note I thought the sterilization/drying function was literally drying, so I tried to dry the dishes after washing them myself, but water sprayed and I was flustered^^;; Later, when I looked at the instruction booklet, it said to rinse/dry without detergent. Be careful when using. And if you don't use it every day, the water inside the strainer will not drain completely and will be stuck, so you should remove it so that the dishwasher doesn't smell musty the next time you use it. Also, be sure to use solid detergent~ If you use the dishwasher after pre-washing, you can use it much more cleanly. Overall review: The Mydia automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher has many convenient and useful functions and is easy to use, so it seems to be a must-have home appliance for housewives who are tired of housework or busy modern people. I highly recommend it~ It's so convenient and good, so try it once. No worries about it being clean. NO NO~~~ It's so shiny without a single water stain~~ I love the free time saved from washing dishes for a long time, and I'm very satisfied with the improved quality of life. Thanks to this, my hands are soft and smooth~^^ It got a bit long because I listed the advantages because I was very satisfied with using it. I hope it was of some help in your purchase.

This is an honest review written after using the product provided for free as part of a Coupang experience group event. I am a meticulous person, so it takes a long time to wash dishes. As I get older, my hands get wet from time to time, and I also get back pain from frequent housework. So, I was thinking about installing a dishwasher when I moved, but since we are a family of two, I was worried that I would only do things myself. Then, rather than installing a large-capacity dishwasher, I looked into a portable, small-capacity dishwasher. Then, I found the Mydia 6-person automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher and got a great opportunity to try it out. The delivery was made the next day by a delivery person who visited me in person and installed it by drilling a small 10mm hole in the kitchen countertop so that it didn't look bad from an aesthetic standpoint. He kindly explained how to use it and tested it, so it wasn't too difficult. I will write down the pros and cons that I felt after using it for two weeks from that evening. The 6-person dishwasher has a slim two-tier structure with a white color and a round design, so it looks simple and luxurious no matter where it is placed in the kitchen. Sterilization/drying. Low temperature. Powerful. Normal. Depending on the washing temperature and the number of rinses, you can choose from four courses according to the level of contamination of the dishes, allowing for more thorough washing. The LED display and control method allow for easy and simple operation, and the two-tier basket makes it easy to store and wash everything from small dishes to greasy dishes such as pots and frying pans. The upper, middle, and lower three-tier washing wings spray powerful washing water to clean between dishes without stains, and the soaking function is excellent for removing stuck-on food (there is a strainer at the bottom to filter out any remaining residue, so please wash it once in a while). The window-type door type allows you to see the washing process with your eyes, so it is not stuffy, and you can see if the washing wings are working properly without getting caught on the dishes, and if the dishes are being washed well, so you can feel secure. You can add additional dishes after operation, so you can wash without losing any dishes. If you set the hot air drying function in advance, the high-temperature hot air will remove the air filled inside the dishwasher during the final stage of washing, and after completion, the automatic door opening function will slightly open the door to discharge the moisture inside the dishwasher. It slowly dries the dishes, removing musty smells and moisture. Among the many advantages, I am most satisfied with the automatic door opening function along with the window door. Disadvantages & regrets *Energy efficiency is level 4 *For 6 people -> It is difficult to wash dishes for 6 people. Be careful when using. And if you don't use it every day, the water inside the strainer will not drain completely and will be stuck, so you should remove it so that the dishwasher doesn't smell musty the next time you use it. Also, be sure to use solid detergent~ If you use the dishwasher after pre-washing, you can use it much more cleanly. Overall review: The Mydia automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher has many convenient and useful functions and is easy to use, so it seems to be a must-have home appliance for housewives who are tired of housework or busy modern people. I highly recommend it~ It's so convenient and good, so try it once. No worries about it being clean. NO NO~~~ It's so shiny without a single water stain~~ I love the free time saved from washing dishes for a long time, and I'm very satisfied with the improved quality of life. Thanks to this, my hands are soft and smooth~^^ It got a bit long because I listed the advantages because I was very satisfied with using it. I hope it was of some help in your purchase.

The shelf height is easily adjustable, allowing for flexible settings for different cups and glasses. The drying power is also excellent. The hot air dryer keeps dishes fluffy and dry, and leaving the door slightly open after washing quickly removes any remaining moisture. Just organizing the dishes after washing used to be a chore, but now, thanks to this dishwasher, my kitchen work has been cut in half. I was even more satisfied with the 10% rebate. Overall, the design, performance, and hygiene are all perfect. I wholeheartedly recommend this dishwasher to anyone looking for a quiet and clean dishwasher.

Overall review: The Mydia automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher has many convenient and useful functions and is easy to use, so it seems to be a must-have home appliance for housewives who are tired of housework or busy modern people. NO NO~~~ It's so shiny without a single water stain~~ I love the free time saved from washing dishes for a long time, and I'm very satisfied with the improved quality of life. I am a meticulous person, so washing dishes takes a long time. As I get older, my hands get wet from time to time, and I also get back pain from frequent housework. So I was thinking about installing a dishwasher when I moved, but since we are a family of two, I was worried that I would only do things myself. While I was looking for a portable, small-capacity dishwasher rather than a large-capacity one, I found the Mydia Automatic Door Open UV Lamp Dishwasher for 6 people and got a great opportunity to try it out. The delivery was made the next day by a delivery person who visited me in person and installed it by drilling a small 10mm hole in the kitchen countertop so that it didn't look bad from an aesthetic standpoint. He kindly explained how to use it and tested it, so it wasn't too difficult. I've been using it for two weeks since that evening and I'll write down the pros and cons that I felt. The 6-person dishwasher is white in color, has a slim two-tier structure with a round design, and is simple and can be placed anywhere in the kitchen. It's luxurious. You can choose from four courses, such as sterilization/drying, low temperature, strong, and normal, depending on the washing temperature and the number of rinses, depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes, allowing for more thorough washing. The LED display and control method allow for easy and simple operation, and the two-tier basket makes it easy to store and wash everything from small dishes to greasy dishes such as pots and frying pans. It has three-tier washing wings (upper, middle, and lower) that spray powerful washing water to clean between dishes without stains, and the soaking function is excellent for removing stuck-on food (there is a strainer at the bottom to filter out any remaining residue, so please wash it once in a while). The window-type door type allows you to see the washing process with your eyes, so it's not stuffy, and you can see if the washing wings are working properly without getting caught on the dishes, and if the dishes are being washed well, which is reassuring. You can add additional dishes after operation, so you can wash without losing any dishes. If you set the hot air drying function in advance, the high-temperature hot air will remove the air filled inside the dishwasher during the final stage of washing, and after completion, the automatic door opening function will slightly open the door and the dishwasher. It slowly dries dishes by releasing the moisture inside, eliminating musty smells and moisture, so among the many advantages, I am most satisfied with the automatic door opening function along with the window-type door. Disadvantages & regrets * Energy efficiency is only level 4 * 6 people -> It is difficult to wash dishes for 6 people. Be careful when using. And if you don't use it every day, the water inside the strainer will not drain completely and will be stuck, so you should remove it so that the dishwasher doesn't smell musty the next time you use it. Also, be sure to use solid detergent~ If you use the dishwasher after pre-washing, you can use it much more cleanly. Overall review: The Mydia automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher has many convenient and useful functions and is easy to use, so it seems to be a must-have home appliance for housewives who are tired of housework or busy modern people. I highly recommend it~ It's so convenient and good after using it, so try it once. No worries about it being clean. NO NO~~~ It's so shiny without a single water stain~~ I love the free time saved from washing dishes for a long time, and I'm very satisfied with the improved quality of life. Thanks to this, my hands are soft and smooth~^^ It got a bit long because I listed the advantages because I'm very satisfied with using it. I hope it was a little helpful in your purchase.

You can add additional dishes after operation, so you can wash without losing any dishes. If you set the hot air drying function in advance, the high-temperature hot air will remove the air filled inside the dishwasher during the final stage of washing, and after completion, the automatic door opening function will slightly open the door and the dishwasher. Be careful when using. And if you don't use it every day, the water inside the strainer will not drain completely and will be stuck, so you should remove it so that the dishwasher doesn't smell musty the next time you use it. Also, be sure to use solid detergent~ If you use the dishwasher after pre-washing, you can use it much more cleanly. Overall review: The Mydia automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher has many convenient and useful functions and is easy to use, so it seems to be a must-have home appliance for housewives who are tired of housework or busy modern people. Comments (English): [ It's just one dishwasher, but it really changes the quality of life~^^ ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I am a meticulous person, so washing dishes takes a long time. As I get older, my hands get wet from time to time, and I also get back pain from frequent housework. So I was thinking about installing a dishwasher when I moved, but since we are a family of two, I was worried that I would only do things myself. While I was looking for a portable, small-capacity dishwasher rather than a large-capacity one, I found the Mydia Automatic Door Open UV Lamp Dishwasher for 6 people and got a great opportunity to try it out. The delivery was made the next day by a delivery person who visited me in person and installed it by drilling a small 10mm hole in the kitchen countertop so that it didn't look bad from an aesthetic standpoint. He kindly explained how to use it and tested it, so it wasn't too difficult. I've been using it for two weeks since that evening and I'll write down the pros and cons that I felt. The 6-person dishwasher is white in color, has a slim two-tier structure with a round design, and is simple and can be placed anywhere in the kitchen. It's luxurious. You can choose from four courses, such as sterilization/drying, low temperature, strong, and normal, depending on the washing temperature and the number of rinses, depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes, allowing for more thorough washing. The LED display and control method allow for easy and simple operation, and the two-tier basket makes it easy to store and wash everything from small dishes to greasy dishes such as pots and frying pans. It has three-tier washing wings (upper, middle, and lower) that spray powerful washing water to clean between dishes without stains, and the soaking function is excellent for removing stuck-on food (there is a strainer at the bottom to filter out any remaining residue, so please wash it once in a while). The window-type door type allows you to see the washing process with your eyes, so it's not stuffy, and you can see if the washing wings are working properly without getting caught on the dishes, and if the dishes are being washed well, which is reassuring. You can add additional dishes after operation, so you can wash without losing any dishes. If you set the hot air drying function in advance, the high-temperature hot air will remove the air filled inside the dishwasher during the final stage of washing, and after completion, the automatic door opening function will slightly open the door and the dishwasher. It slowly dries dishes by releasing the moisture inside, eliminating musty smells and moisture, so among the many advantages, I am most satisfied with the automatic door opening function along with the window-type door. Disadvantages & regrets * Energy efficiency is only level 4 * 6 people -> It is difficult to wash dishes for 6 people. It is suitable for washing dishes for 2 to 4 people * The sterilization/drying function is not a drying function alone, but a rinse/drying function * Even after washing is complete after hot air drying, some moisture remains on the dishes, and in particular, some water is collected on the top of the cups ** Note I thought the sterilization/drying function was literally drying, so I tried to dry the dishes after washing them myself, but water sprayed and I was flustered^^;; Later, when I looked at the instruction booklet, it said to rinse/dry without detergent. Be careful when using. And if you don't use it every day, the water inside the strainer will not drain completely and will be stuck, so you should remove it so that the dishwasher doesn't smell musty the next time you use it. Also, be sure to use solid detergent~ If you use the dishwasher after pre-washing, you can use it much more cleanly. Overall review: The Mydia automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher has many convenient and useful functions and is easy to use, so it seems to be a must-have home appliance for housewives who are tired of housework or busy modern people. I highly recommend it~ It's so convenient and good after using it, so try it once. No worries about it being clean. NO NO~~~ It's so shiny without a single water stain~~ I love the free time saved from washing dishes for a long time, and I'm very satisfied with the improved quality of life. Thanks to this, my hands are soft and smooth~^^ It got a bit long because I listed the advantages because I'm very satisfied with using it. I hope it was a little helpful in your purchase.

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ I just got a dishwasher, but it has completely changed my quality of life. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I received the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event and wrote this review honestly after using it. Due to my meticulous nature, washing dishes tends to take a long time for me. As I get older, I've also developed back pain from my hands getting damp and frequent housework. I considered installing a dishwasher when moving, but since we are a family of two and I wondered if we would just do the dishes by hand, I hesitated. Instead of installing a large-capacity unit, I looked into a portable, smaller-capacity dishwasher first, and that's when I discovered the My Dear Automatic Door Opening UV Lamp Dishwasher (6-place setting). I was fortunate to get this great opportunity to try it out. For delivery, a technician visited my home the next day and installed it by drilling a small 10mm hole into the kitchen countertop so it didn't look unsightly. Thanks to their kind explanation of the operation and a test run, it wasn't difficult at all. I will now write about the pros and cons I have experienced after using it for two weeks, starting from that evening. This 6-place setting dishwasher features a slim, two-tier structure with a rounded design in white, looking simple yet luxurious wherever you place it in the kitchen. It offers four washing cycles—Sterilization/Drying, Low Temperature, Powerful, and Standard—varying by temperature and number of rinses, allowing you to select the appropriate setting based on the soil level of your dishes for a cleaner wash. The LED display and control system make operation easy and convenient, and the two-tier basket facilitates the storage and washing of everything from small dishes to greasy items like pots and pans. The three-stage washing blades (upper, middle, and lower) spray powerful water to clean stain-free between dishes, and the soaking function is excellent for removing stuck-on food residue (please rinse the bottom mesh occasionally to filter out any remaining debris). The window-type door allows you to visually monitor the washing process, providing peace of mind by letting you see if the blades are working properly without getting caught on dishes and if the dishes are being cleaned thoroughly. You can also add dishes after the cycle is complete, ensuring no items fall out. If you pre-set the hot air drying function, high-temperature hot air removes the air filling the dishwasher during the final wash stage. After completion, the automatic door opening feature slightly opens to release moisture, allowing the dishes to dry slowly and eliminate musty odors and dampness. Among the many advantages, I find the automatic door opening function, along with the window-style door, to be the most satisfying. Disadvantages & Areas for Improvement: *Energy efficiency is only level 4. *It is rated for 6-place dishes, but washing 6-place dishes is difficult. Washing 2-4 place dishes is more suitable. *The sterilization/drying function is a rinse/drying function, not a standalone drying function. *Even after the wash is complete following hot air drying, some moisture remains on the dishes, and water tends to pool on top of the cups. **Note: I was surprised when water sprayed out because I tried to dry the dishes manually after washing them, thinking the sterilization/drying function was literally drying. I later checked the manual and realized it is a rinse/drying function without detergent. Please be careful when using it. Also, if you don't use it every day, water may pool inside the strainer, so you should remove it to prevent a musty smell during the next use. Also, be sure to use solid detergent. Pre-washing before using the dishwasher ensures a much cleaner result. Overall Review: The MyDear Automatic Door Opening UV Lamp Dishwasher has many convenient and useful features and is easy to operate. I highly recommend it as an essential appliance for housewives exhausted from housework or busy modern people. It is so convenient and great to use, so please give it a try. No need to worry about it being clean. It shines squeaky clean without a single water stain. I love the extra time saved from long dishwashing sessions, and my quality of life has improved, so I am very satisfied. Thanks to this, my hands are nice and dry too. I was so satisfied with the experience that I ended up listing the advantages, which made this review a bit long. I hope this helps you with your purchase.

The three-stage washing blades (upper, middle, and lower) spray powerful water to clean stain-free between dishes, and the soaking function is excellent for removing stuck-on food residue (please rinse the bottom mesh occasionally to filter out any remaining debris). You can also add dishes after the cycle is complete, ensuring no items fall out. If you pre-set the hot air drying function, high-temperature hot air removes the air filling the dishwasher during the final wash stage. After completion, the automatic door opening feature slightly opens to release moisture, allowing the dishes to dry slowly and eliminate musty odors and dampness. Among the many advantages, I find the automatic door opening function, along with the window-style door, to be the most satisfying. Pre-washing before using the dishwasher ensures a much cleaner result. I love the extra time saved from long dishwashing sessions, and my quality of life has improved, so I am very satisfied. Thanks to this, my hands are nice and dry too. I was so satisfied with the experience that I ended up listing the advantages, which made this review a bit long. I hope this helps you with your purchase.

You can also add dishes after the cycle is complete, ensuring no items fall out. After completion, the automatic door opening feature slightly opens to release moisture, allowing the dishes to dry slowly and eliminate musty odors and dampness. Among the many advantages, I find the automatic door opening function, along with the window-style door, to be the most satisfying. Pre-washing before using the dishwasher ensures a much cleaner result. I highly recommend it as an essential appliance for housewives exhausted from housework or busy modern people. It is so convenient and great to use, so please give it a try. I love the extra time saved from long dishwashing sessions, and my quality of life has improved, so I am very satisfied. Thanks to this, my hands are nice and dry too. I was so satisfied with the experience that I ended up listing the advantages, which made this review a bit long. I hope this helps you with your purchase.

Sentence (English): I sincerely recommend this to anyone looking for a quiet and neat dishwasher.
Comments (English): LG Electronics Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher, 14-place setting. 3-stage stacking possible; a 14-place setting with plenty of room even if you just throw everything in. Salt, detergent, and rinse aid required! As of November 8th, I am using it very well. Calling all those considering the silver color! I was very worried about scratches, but there are absolutely no issues. I was short-sighted and placed the water purifier incorrectly, so it is now on top of the dishwasher. Even though the kids use the footrest to pull it out, it is surprisingly resistant to scratches. Also, when using the hot air function, it opens slightly; even if the kids move their hands over it, it doesn't get hot and is fine. Since the dishwasher keeps squeaking and opening again while the dishes are drying, the baby waits right in front of it and keeps closing it. Also, the sink installer removed the molding he added during installation because he said it would be soaked in water, so the top of the dishwasher looked bare. Is there a cover on the dishwasher itself? I did have something similar, but it wasn't pretty, so I attached the thinnest square wire molding I could find for a few thousand won, and it fit perfectly. I recommend this to anyone who might be unsure about molding. I recently installed a 14-place setting dishwasher while remodeling my kitchen. Honestly, since this is my first time using a proper dishwasher, I was a bit skeptical, but I find myself thinking I should have gotten one sooner. I used to use a mini, drill-free version, and I didn't realize it until I used that one, but using an expensive one makes a huge difference. Since most of the appliances in my house are LG, I chose LG again this time. Because my baseboard is 15cm, only the 10cm model from Samsung was available. I deliberated carefully to choose the stainless steel color, and the design is incredibly sophisticated. It matches the kitchen door color well, and since it's built-in, it makes for a clean use of space. There is also almost no noise when it operates. It is quiet enough that you can have a conversation right next to it without disturbing anyone. I am satisfied with the performance as well. It features hot air drying and steam sterilization, so I feel safe regarding hygiene. I’ve tried putting in a variety of items, from glass cups and baby tableware to stainless steel pots, and they all come out sparkling clean without any water stains. It feels so refreshing that the grease and odors that used to linger no matter how much I scrubbed with a scouring pad have completely disappeared. The steam function is especially great; it cleans greasy plates and frying pans perfectly without needing to rinse them beforehand. Since it has a 14-place setting capacity, the ample space means I can handle all my dishes by running it just once a day. The internal basket structure is well-designed, so even large pots and cutting boards fit inside as long as the angles are set correctly. Adjusting the shelf height is also easy, allowing me to flexibly set it up according to the type of cups or glasses. The drying performance is excellent as well. Thanks to the hot air drying, everything dries completely dry and fluffy, and any remaining moisture disappears quickly if you leave the door slightly ajar after the wash. In the past, just organizing dishes after washing was a chore, but now, thanks to this dishwasher, my kitchen work has been cut in half. I was even more satisfied because I received a 10% cashback. Overall, the design, performance, and hygiene are all perfect. I sincerely recommend this to anyone looking for a quiet and neat dishwasher.

Sentence (English): My wife and I decided that buying a dishwasher was a must when we moved.
Comments (English): [ I finally decided to bite the bullet and buy an LG Objet dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || My wife and I decided that buying a dishwasher was a must when we moved. We wanted to get a pretty one if we were going to buy one anyway. So, from the start, we only looked at the LG Objet Collection. The higher-end models with steam were a bit too expensive. We don't tend to cook roughly, so we decided to let go of our desire for performance and focus on the design. That is how we chose the non-steam DUE1BGLE model. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- - Installation and Additional Costs. I ordered it from Coupang using a credit card discount. As expected, delivery was fast. However, there was a bit of a variable during installation. Our sink structure is unique, so the base cabinets had to be modified slightly. The work started immediately on-site, and the additional cost was 80,000 won. It was an unexpected expense, but the technician explained everything in advance. I felt confident because I confirmed how the work would be done and the cost beforehand. The finish was also neat. - Actual User Review. To start with the conclusion, it is really convenient. - As expected, the design. That is the biggest reason I chose this. The clean beige color changes the atmosphere of the kitchen. The lines are sharp, just like a built-in unit. I feel proud every time I look at it. - Cleaning Power is also decent. I was worried because it didn't have steam, but thankfully it did. It cleans everyday dishes very thoroughly. Rice grains or coffee stains are no problem. I also like the 80-degree high-temperature sterilization. You can feel the intense heat after the wash is finished. It gives me confidence that the dishes have been thoroughly disinfected, so I put my child's tableware in with peace of mind. - Areas for Improvement. Of course, there are definitely limitations. Pots with burnt-on food like curry require pre-washing. If you just put them in, the seasoning sometimes remains. In these situations, I miss the steam function, but the price is almost double... - Final Summary. If design is your top priority, it is a choice you won't regret. The luxury of having a cup of tea with my wife instead of doing the evening dishes is fully satisfying. TIP). Be sure to apply for the 10% rebate for Top Efficiency Appliances! As of mid-October, they say 40% of the budget remains.

Sentence (English): You know how much of a hassle it is to wash small dishes (like lunch boxes or large plates), even smaller ones?
Comments (English): [ Use the Minix dishwasher and get your hands wet less! ] || ---------------- || You know how much of a hassle it is to wash small dishes (like lunch boxes or large plates), even smaller ones? You have to scrub them by hand, place them on the rack, let them air dry, and then they end up covered in water stains. ;; I was thinking about buying a dishwasher, but I got the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO after being invited to a Coupang Experience Group! It even has a drying function. (Wow.) It's a little bigger than I thought, but the space next to my sink is quite spacious, so it's perfect for storing them. It's easy to install, and there's no need for any special installation. Just take it out of the box, put it on, and connect the power cord. I don't want to bother with the drain, so I just fill a bucket with water and use it. It's not a hassle at all. But if I have to run it multiple times, I fill a large bucket with water and fill it with water. First, I put in and spun the rice bowl, bowl, spoon, and scissors that were stained with red grease from eating octopus. As for the space inside, there are two trays, so I put rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, etc. in the lower tray, and scissors, soy sauce paper, and spoons in the upper tray. Since we're a family of six, there were quite a lot, so I played Tetris (?) and loaded them all up, and about 80% of the items I used fit. And the most important thing: the washing function! I ran it once on strong for two hours. Seriously, all the grease was gone. I took it out after running it all and checked it, and it was squeaky clean. It felt cleaner than my own dishes? It's a whole new world. I wonder why I only started using it now. Even running it on standard for an hour cleans everything thoroughly. The upper and lower spray nozzles and tornado rotation (or something like that) are even better. The modes are economy, standard, strong, quick, interior wash, and drying. There are only 6 items, but it has only the necessities, and it's not difficult to use. Just set the operating mode and press the start button! It dries, so there are no water marks and you don't have to take it out and put it on the tray. And the noise. It's just like the noise of everyday life? It's not annoying or anything, just right. It's not too loud, so you don't have to worry. To summarize, it's a dishwasher with excellent cleaning functions for the price! It's a 6-person household, so space is limited, but it's probably perfect for a 2-person household! Let's all use the Minix dishwasher and reduce the number of times we get our hands wet.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher months.
Comments (English): [ Doesn't Dry & Smells Bad-- Even on "Extra Dry" ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher months. I'm not crazy about the capacity on the lower rack. My old washer fit a lot more large pasta bowls, which is what we use a lot. The worse things is that it doesn't dry the dishes, even if I turn on High Heat Wash AND Extra Dry. Overnight Dry doesn't dry at all, either. Dishes smell bad when I take them out, even if they've only been in the washer overnight. I do clean the filter at least weekly, and I do rinse my dishes before loading, so there can't be that much crud in the filter. There's barely anything visible in it when I clean it. The entire inside of the washer remains very wet even after Extra Dry cycle. I dry the door with a microfiber rag, but I'm not going to take out the rack and wipe the entire interior. Keeping the door open all day is not an option because that would be a hazard in the kitchen. I don't know if all dishwashers are like this now days, due to trying to make them energy efficient. My previous washer came for free off a neighbors lawn, during the pandemic, (when I couldn't buy a new one) and did a much better job.

Sentence (English): We replaced our previous dishwasher (a still working Bosch) to get a stainless version.
Comments (English): [ Less capable then previous Bosch ] || ---------------- || We replaced our previous dishwasher (a still working Bosch) to get a stainless version. We upgraded to the 800 series and didn't find it until we had it installed that, unlike our previous Bosch, it does Not have a time delay. The only way to delay a cycle is to download the phone app and schedule it each time on the phone. On our previous Bosch, we finished dinner, loaded the dishwasher and set it to come on after we went to bed. I have no doubt at all that the software for the 800 could be updated to allow for a "favorite" with a time delay could be set once with a phone and then selected each time from the door controls. But that is not possible now. Not everyone, especially those that are buying your top of the line models, want to have to use their phones everyday to set the dishwasher. Make life simpler, not more involved, please!

The Bosch washer was installed 3 days later, and the frustrations began. As I said in the title, it does a good job of cleaning, but convenience in loading and unloading leaves a lot to be desired, compared to my former unit. My former unit may have had a touch of "commercial" to it, but the racks EASILY accomodated dishes and glasses in two "straight up and down" racks, one deep for large dishes and one rack a little shallower, for glasses and small bowls. The Bosch unit, has a "mish-mosh" of tines, set up in what appears to be in a random array of heights, which I find to be incompatible with my dishes. And the "silverware" shelf, at the top of unit, which accomodates spoons, knives, and forks, INDIVIDUALLY, is a bad joke. You have to load and unload it piece by piece. Ridiculous and time consuming. I've run 3 loads of dishes with this unit, so far, and I'm seriously considering asking the store I bought it from if they would take it back.

Sentence (English): We have owned our home for 30 years and have had Whirlpool, Kitchen Aid, LG and Samsung dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Love it! ] || ---------------- || We have owned our home for 30 years and have had Whirlpool, Kitchen Aid, LG and Samsung dishwashers. All have failed in one way or the other except the original, basic model Whirlpool. The Kitchen Aid and LG never cleaned the dishes very well and the Samsung succumed to the infamous Samsung leak. We have had the Bosch for a month now and could not be happier! The dishes come out sparkling clean! Use of the Finish product makes the dishes dry and spotless at the end of the cycle. We quickly learned that was necessary. The app works very well and as a new owner we appreciate the hints and tips offered with being nagging. The organizating of all the dish holders is excellent and adaptable to all dish sizes and configurations. We love the third rack and dry all of our silverware up there rather then using the small holder that is supplied. Again the orginization of the third rack is excellent like the other racks and we look forward to a long life with our new Bosch!

I like it. ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Reason for Purchase: I previously used a small dishwasher for 1-3 people. I thought it was incredibly convenient back then, but the small capacity meant it would quickly fill up with just a few dishes, sometimes requiring multiple runs a day. So, I looked for a slightly larger capacity and settled on a 6-person dishwasher. I was worried it might be too bulky, but it's actually quite slim, perfect for placing next to the sink. It feels a bit larger than a microwave! It's incredibly convenient because it can hold plates, bowls, cups, and even a frying pan all at once, and the ample storage space has significantly reduced the stress of washing dishes. Pros: 1. Ample storage space: Being able to load multiple items, from plates to cups, at once is much more convenient than before. Compared to a smaller dishwasher, it definitely feels more spacious. 2. Auto-opening feature (the best!): I love how the door automatically opens after each wash cycle, allowing moisture to escape and drying the dishes fluffy. I even left it on at night without any problems. 3. Transparent window design: Seeing inside while washing is reassuring, and the white color blends well with the kitchen décor. 4. UV sterilization function: It not only washes dishes, but it also sterilizes them, so I trust it's hygienic. 5. Quick installation service: The installer came the very next day to install the dishwasher. He kindly helped me position it and gave me a simple explanation of how to use it, so the installation process was very satisfactory! Cons: I haven't experienced any particular inconveniences so far. It's a good idea to check the dishwasher's placement and water connection locations before installation. Overall Review: Upgrading from a small dishwasher to a six-person dishwasher definitely has more storage space. Not only does it save time by not having to run it multiple times a day, but the automatic door opening also keeps the dishwasher dry. Above all, the quick installation and friendly installation were all very helpful. Since this is an appliance I use every day in the kitchen, it's made my life much more convenient. If you're planning on getting a dishwasher for your aunt, the automatic door opening is a must! Highly recommended! ^^ If you found my review helpful, please click the "Helpful" button!

Sentence (English): I've been using the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater dishwasher for about a month.
Comments (English): [ This is it ] || ---------------- || I've been using the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater dishwasher for about a month. When it was first installed, the technician meticulously adjusted it, so it fit perfectly into the built-in cabinet. The design is truly sophisticated. It blends well with my kitchen interior, and I like how it looks more like furniture than an appliance. I'm also satisfied with its quietness, and its cleaning power is definitely excellent. I used to wash dishes by hand, but now I put almost all of them in the dishwasher. Even dishes with food stains, like rice bowls and soup bowls, are thoroughly cleaned with the basic cycle. The drying function is particularly excellent, so there are almost no water marks left. It also has an odor removal function, so there's no damp smell after washing. It's also quiet, so my family can use it comfortably at night without worrying about it. However, it's a bit difficult to load large pots or frying pans at once because the space underneath needs to be adjusted. Plastic tableware tends to warp slightly when dried at high temperatures, so be careful. While the price is high, the perceived cost is slightly reduced with the rebate program, which is a good deal. The design, cleaning power, and quietness are all well-balanced. I think it's a premium product. Pros: Stylish design blends well with the kitchen. Excellent cleaning and drying power.
